info.description: Cypherpunk Technologies, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing targeted and immuno-oncology therapeutics. Its novel therapies are designed to treat patients with cancer. The company was founded on January 3, 2011 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Cypherpunk Technologies, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發標靶和免疫腫瘤療法。其新穎療法旨在治療癌症患者。該公司成立於2011年1月3日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Simplify Bitcoin Strategy PLUS Income ETF seeks income and capital gains. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (an "ETF"). The fund's adviser seeks to achieve its investment objective by using three strategies: (1) a Bitcoin futures strategy, (2) an income strategy, and (3) an option overlay strategy. Even though the adviser employs three strategies, the fund's portfolio is composed primarily of income producing securities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 簡化比特幣策略加收入 ETF 尋求收入和資本利得。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金的顧問尋求透過使用三種策略來實現其投資目標：（1）比特幣期貨策略，（2）收入策略，以及（3）選擇權覆蓋策略。儘管顧問採用三種策略，但該基金的投資組合主要由創收證券組成。它是非多元化的。

info.description: The Hain Celestial Group, Inc. engages in the production and distribution of organic and natural products. It operates through North America and International geographical segments. The North America segment consists of the United States and Canada. The International segment includes the United Kingdom, Ella's Kitchen UK, and Europe. The company was founded by Irwin David Simon on May 19, 1993 and is headquartered in Hoboken, NJ.
info.description_zh: Hain Celestial Group, Inc. 從事有機和天然產品的生產和分銷。它透過北美和國際地理部門開展業務。北美部分包括美國和加拿大。國際部分包括英國、Ella's Kitchen UK 和歐洲。該公司由 Irwin David Simon 於 1993 年 5 月 19 日創立，總部位於新澤西州霍博肯。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CRCL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of CRCL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CRCL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CRCL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 CRCL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具綜合起來為 CRCL 的價格提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Strive, Inc. engages in the provision of an asset management Bitcoin treasury. It is focused on maximizing value for shareholders, accumulating bitcoin and outperforming bitcoin over the long run. The company was founded by Arshia Sarkhani, Jackson Fairbanks, Arman Sarkhani, and Kyle Fairbanks on March 9, 2022 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Strive, Inc. 從事提供資產管理比特幣金庫業務。它專注於為股東實現價值最大化、累積比特幣並從長遠來看超越比特幣。該公司由 Arshia Sarkhani、Jackson Fairbanks、Arman Sarkhani 和 Kyle Fairbanks 於 2022 年 3 月 9 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: 2x XRP ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of XRP. The fund is an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through managed exposure to XRP futures contracts that trade only on an exchange registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("XRP Futures Contracts"), and cash, cash-like instruments or high-quality securities that serve as collateral to the fund's investments in XRP Futures Contracts ("Collateral Investments"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 2x XRP ETF 尋求扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於 XRP 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金是一檔交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過管理 XRP 期貨合約（僅在商品期貨交易委員會註冊的交易所交易）（「XRP 期貨合約」）以及作為基金 XRP 期貨合約投資抵押品的現金、類現金工具或高品質證券（「抵押投資」）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Maravai Lifesciences Holdings, Inc. engages in providing products to enable the development of drug therapies, diagnostics, and novel vaccines and to support research on human diseases. The firm's brands include TriLink BioTechnologies, Cygnus, Glen Research, and Alphazyme. It operates through the TriLink and Cygnus segments. The TriLink segment manufactures and sells products used in the fields of gene therapy, vaccines, nucleoside chemistry, oligonucleotide therapy and molecular diagnostics, including reagents used in the chemical synthesis, modification, labelling, and purification of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) and ribonucleic acid (RNA). The Cygnus segment sells biologic safety testing products and highly specialized analytical products for use in biologic manufacturing process development, including custom product-specific antibody and assay development services. It also operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Latin and Central America. The company was founded by Eric Tardif and Carl W. Hull in March 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Maravai Lifesciences Holdings, Inc. 致力於提供產品，以促進藥物治療、診斷和新型疫苗的開發，並支持人類疾病的研究。該公司的品牌包括 TriLink BioTechnologies、Cygnus、Glen Research 和 Alphazyme。它透過 TriLink 和 Cygnus 部門運作。 TriLink部門生產和銷售用於基因治療、疫苗、核苷化學、寡核苷酸治療和分子診斷領域的產品，包括用於脫氧核糖核酸（DNA）和核糖核酸（RNA）的化學合成、修飾、標記和純化的試劑。 Cygnus 部門銷售生物安全測試產品和高度專業化的分析產品，用於生物製造製程開發，包括客製化產品特定抗體和檢測開發服務。它也透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、亞太地區、歐洲、中東、非洲以及拉丁美洲和中美洲。該公司由 Eric Tardif 和 Carl W. Hull 於 2014 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Direxion Daily COIN Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of COIN. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of COIN and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to COIN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily COIN Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 COIN 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 COIN 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些組合起來提供 2 倍的每日 COIN 槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Upexi, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of consumer products through direct-to-consumer network, wholesale partnerships, and major third-party platforms like Amazon. Its brands include LuckyTail, Prax, Cure Mushrooms, Moonwlkr, and Gumi Labs. The company was founded on September 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: Upexi, Inc. 透過直接面向消費者的網路、批發合作夥伴以及亞馬遜等主要第三方平台從事消費品的開發、製造和分銷。其品牌包括 LuckyTail、Prax、Cure Mushrooms、Moonwlkr 和 Gumi Labs。該公司成立於2018年9月5日，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: 21Shares 2x Long HYPE ETF is a leveraged exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide 200% of the daily price performance of Hyperliquid (HYPE). The fund does not invest directly in the underlying digital asset; instead, it utilizes derivative instruments-primarily swap agreements, futures, and options-to achieve its target exposure. Designed as a tactical trading vehicle, the fund resets its leverage daily and is intended for sophisticated investors to manage short-term directional views.
info.description_zh: 21Shares 2x Long HYPE ETF 是一款槓桿交易所交易基金，旨在提供 Hyperliquid (HYPE) 200% 的每日價格表現。該基金不直接投資於標的數位資產；相反，它利用衍生性工具——主要是掉期協議、期貨和選擇權——來實現其目標敞口。該基金被設計為戰術交易工具，每日重置槓桿，旨在幫助經驗豐富的投資者管理短期方向觀點。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MSTR Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of MicroStrategy Inc. (NASDAQ: MSTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock. At the end of each trading day, the notional exposure against the underlying stock obtained through the combination of these instruments will be approximately 200% of the fund's net asset value. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MSTR Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 MicroStrategy Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MSTR）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。在每個交易日結束時，透過這些工具的組合獲得的標的股票的名義曝險將約為基金資產淨值的200%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: NEOS Boosted Bitcoin High Income ETF seeks to boost performance by generating high monthly income with the potential for appreciation based on exposure to exchange-traded products (ETPs) that have direct exposure to Bitcoin. The fund implements a multi-part strategy including a 100% core exposure to spot Bitcoin ETPs and an additional synthetic options strategy designed to create approximately 150% notional portfolio exposure, while generating income through a data-driven call option overlay.
info.description_zh: NEOS Boosted Bitcoin High Income ETF 尋求透過產生高額月收入來提高業績，並且基於直接接觸比特幣的交易所交易產品 (ETP) 的升值潛力。該基金實施多部分策略，包括 100% 核心敞口為現貨比特幣 ETP，以及額外的合成期權策略，旨在創建約 150% 名義投資組合敞口，同時透過數據驅動的看漲期權疊加產生收入。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long MSTR ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of 2.00 (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of MSTR. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with financial institutions for a specified period, which may range from one day to longer than a year. The advisor has adopted a policy to have at least 80% exposure to financial instruments with economic characteristics that should perform 2X the daily performance of the underlying security's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long MSTR ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 MSTR 股價每日百分比變化的 2.00 (200%)。該基金將與金融機構簽訂一項或多項在指定期限內的掉期協議，期限可能從一天到一年以上。顧問已採取一項政策，要求至少 80% 的金融工具具有經濟特徵，其表現應是基礎證券股票每日表現的 2 倍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CoinShares Altcoins ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in the securities of investment vehicles that offer exposure to the digital assets that comprise the CoinShares-Compass Crypto Market 35% Capped Index. The index is a diversified digital asset index which seeks to track the performance of the ten largest digital assets by market capitalization, weighted according to their market capitalization with a maximum weighting of 35%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: CoinShares Altcoins ETF 旨在提供資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於投資工具的證券，這些投資工具提供構成 CoinShares-Compass 加密貨幣市場 35% 上限指數的數位資產的曝險。該指數是一個多元化的數位資產指數，旨在追蹤市值最大的十大數位資產的表現，並根據其市值進行加權，最大權重為35%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: DeFi Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of investment services. It plans to acquire equity, debt, or other securities of publicly traded or private companies or other entities. The firm offers DeFi ETNs, DeFi Governance, DeFi Venture and DeFi Treasury. The company was founded by Olivier Francois Roussy Newton and Wouter Witvoet on April 14, 1986 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: DeFi Technologies, Inc.從事提供投資服務。它計劃收購上市公司或私人公司或其他實體的股權、債務或其他證券。該公司提供 DeFi ETN、DeFi 治理、DeFi Venture 和 DeFi Treasury。該公司由 Olivier Francois Roussy Newton 和 Wouter Witvoet 於 1986 年 4 月 14 日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: 21Shares Sui ETF is a passive investment fund designed to provide direct, regulated exposure to SUI, the native token of the Sui Network, by tracking its performance via a specific pricing benchmark. The strategy involves holding physical SUI tokens in institutional-grade custody and seeks to reflect additional rewards generated from staking a portion of the Trust's SUI holdings, net of expenses and liabilities.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Sui ETF 是一款被動投資基金，旨在透過特定定價基準追蹤其表現，為 Sui 網路的原生代幣 SUI 提供直接、受監管的投資。該策略涉及以機構級託管方式持有實體 SUI 代幣，並尋求反映透過質押信託的部分 SUI 持有量（扣除費用和負債）而產生的額外獎勵。

info.description: Defiance Leveraged Long + Income MSTR ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by entering into derivatives transactions (i.e., swap agreements and options contracts) to gain long exposure to MicroStrategy Incorporated ("MSTR," or the "Underlying Security"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Leverged Long + Income MSTR ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過進行衍生性商品交易（即掉期協議和選擇權合約）以獲得 MicroStrategy Incorporated（「MSTR」或「基礎證券」）的長期風險來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ProQR Therapeutics NV is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of RNA therapies for the treatment of severe genetic rare diseases with a focus on inherited retinal diseases. The company was founded by Daniel Anton de Boer, Gerard J. Platenburg, Henri A. Termeer, and Domenico Valerio on February 21, 2012, and is headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: ProQR Therapeutics NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開髮用於治療嚴重遺傳性罕見疾病（尤其是遺傳性視網膜疾病）的 RNA 療法。該公司由 Daniel Anton de Boer、Gerard J. Platenburg、Henri A. Termeer 和 Domenico Valerio 於 2012 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於荷蘭萊頓。

info.description: Canary Litecoin ETF seeks to track the performance of LTC, as measured by the CoinDesk Litecoin Price Index, adjusted for the Trust's expenses and other liabilities. In seeking to achieve its investment objective, the Trust will hold LTC and establish its net asset value ("NAV") on each business day by reference to the index. The index is calculated by applying a weighting algorithm to the price and trading volume data for the immediately preceding 24-hour period as of 4:00 p.m., New York time, derived from the selected digital asset trading platforms (the "Constituent Trading Platforms"). CoinDesk Indices, Inc.
info.description_zh: Canary Litecoin ETF 旨在追蹤 LTC 的表現，根據 CoinDesk Litecoin 價格指數衡量，並根據信託的費用和其他負債進行調整。為了實現其投資目標，信託將持有 LTC 並在每個工作日參考該指數來確定其資產淨值（「NAV」）。該指數的計算方法是對選定數位資產交易平台（「成分交易平台」）截至紐約時間下午 4:00 之前 24 小時內的價格和交易量數據應用加權演算法。 CoinDesk 指數公司

info.description: Tron, Inc. engages in the provision of designing, manufacturing, and sale of toys, souvenirs, and plushies. It offers its services to theme parks and other entertainment ventures. The company was founded on April 22, 2022 and is headquartered in Winter Park, FL.
info.description_zh: Tron, Inc. 從事玩具、紀念品和毛絨玩具的設計、製造和銷售。它為主題公園和其他娛樂企業提供服務。該公司成立於 2022 年 4 月 22 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州溫特帕克。

info.description: 21shares Polkadot ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that provides direct, physically backed exposure to DOT, the native cryptocurrency of the Polkadot network. The fund seeks to track the performance of its underlying digital asset by holding DOT in secure, institutional-grade cold storage, while uniquely incorporating a staking component to capture network rewards that may be used to offset fund expenses or contribute to the net asset value.
info.description_zh: 21shares Polkadot ETF 是一款被動管理的交易所交易基金，提供直接、實物支援的 DOT（Polkadot 網路的原生加密貨幣）曝險。該基金尋求透過將 DOT 保存在安全的機構級冷庫中來追蹤其基礎數位資產的表現，同時獨特地納入質押組件來獲取網路獎勵，這些獎勵可用於抵消基金費用或貢獻淨資產價值。

info.description: IN8bio, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of gamma-delta T cellular therapy product candidates for solid and liquid tumors and gamma-delta T cell engagers for cancer and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded by Lawrence S. Lamb and William T. Ho on February 8, 2016 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: IN8bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於實體和液體腫瘤的 γ-δ T 細胞治療候選產品以及癌症和自體免疫疾病的 γ-δ T 細胞接合劑的發現、開發和商業化。該公司由 Lawrence S. Lamb 和 William T. Ho 於 2016 年 2 月 8 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: 21Shares Hyperliquid ETF provides direct exposure to HYPE tokens, the native digital asset of the decentralized, layer-1 Hyperliquid Network, which features a fully on-chain real-time order book and execution system. The strategy seeks passive tracking of the token's pricing performance while factoring in fund expenses and incorporating staking rewards generated by committing a portion of its digital holdings to validate the underlying blockchain network.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Hyperliquid ETF 提供對 HYPE 代幣的直接投資，HYPE 代幣是去中心化第一層 Hyperliquid 網路的原生數位資產，具有完全鏈上的即時訂單簿和執行系統。該策略尋求被動追蹤代幣的定價表現，同時考慮基金費用，並納入透過承諾部分數位資產來驗證底層區塊鏈網路而產生的質押獎勵。

info.description: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of global maritime shipping services through its subsidiaries. Its services include time chartering and vessel management. The company was founded on July 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司提供全球海運服務。其服务包括期租和船舶管理。該公司成立於2023年7月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: H World Group Ltd. engages in the operation of hotels. It operates through the Legacy Huazhu and Legacy DH segments. The company was founded by Qi Ji, Jiong Wu, and Tong Tong Zhao on January 4, 2007, and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: H World Group Ltd.從事旅館經營業務。它透過Legacy Huazhu 和Legacy DH 部門運作。該公司由季奇、吳炯和趙童童於2007年1月4日創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Canary HBAR ETF seeks to seek to provide exposure to the value of the fund held by the Trust, less the expenses of the Trust's operations. In seeking to achieve the investment objective, the Trust will hold the fund and will value its net assets and the Shares daily based on the Pricing Benchmark. HBAR will be the only digital asset held by the Trust. The Pricing Benchmark is a U.S. dollar-denominated composite reference rate for the price of the fund.
info.description_zh: Canary HBAR ETF 旨在尋求提供信託持有的基金價值減去信託營運費用的曝險。為了實現投資目標，信託將持有該基金，並根據定價基準每日對其淨資產和股份進行估值。 HBAR 將是該信託持有的唯一數位資產。定價基準是以美元計價的基金價格的綜合參考利率。

info.description: Global X Blockchain & Bitcoin Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing directly or indirectly in equity securities of U.S. and non-U.S. "Blockchain Companies" and in long positions in U.S. listed bitcoin futures contracts. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in Blockchain Companies and in long positions on U.S. listed Bitcoin Futures contracts. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 區塊鏈和比特幣策略 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過直接或間接投資於美國和非美國「區塊鏈公司」的股本證券以及美國上市的比特幣期貨合約的多頭部位來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於區塊鏈公司以及美國上市的比特幣期貨合約的多頭部位。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Forward Industries, Inc. is a Solana focused digital asset treasury company, with the strategy to buy, hold, stake, trade, invest in, and grow SOL and SOL related digital assets, protocols and businesses. The firm mission is to expand and strengthen the Solana ecosystem by acquiring and staking SOL and engaging with, providing tools to and investing in the Solana network, Solana developers and Solana related projects in order to increase shareholder value. It operates through the following segments: Design and Digital Assets. The Design segment consists of two operating segments that provide a full spectrum of hardware and software product design and engineering services to customers predominantly located in the U.S. The Digital Assets segment captures SOL-based yield generated by participating in the Solana network's staking protocol, which currently comprises rewards received from native staking. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Forward Industries, Inc. 是一家專注於 Solana 的數位資產財務公司，其策略是購買、持有、入股、交易、投資和發展 SOL 以及 SOL 相關的數位資產、協議和業務。該公司的使命是透過收購和質押 SOL 以及與 Solana 網路、Solana 開發人員和 Solana 相關項目互動、提供工具和投資來擴大和加強 Solana 生態系統，以增加股東價值。它透過以下部門運作：設計和數位資產。設計部門由兩個營運部門組成，為主要位於美國的客戶提供全方位的硬體和軟體產品設計和工程服務。數位資產部門捕獲透過參與 Solana 網路的質押協議產生的基於 SOL 的收益，目前包括從本地質押獲得的獎勵。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Journey Medical Corporation is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development and commercialization of pharmaceutical products for the treatment of dermatological conditions. Its brands include QBREXZA, Accutane, Targadox, AMZEEQ, Ximino, ZILXI, Exelderm, and Luxamend. The company was founded by Claude Maraoui in October 2014 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Journey Medical Corporation 是一家商業階段的製藥公司，專注於治療皮膚病的藥品的開發和商業化。其品牌包括 QBREXZA、Accutane、Targadox、AMZEEQ、Ximino、ZILXI、Exelderm 和 Luxamend。該公司由 Claude Maraoui 於 2014 年 10 月創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Pilgrim's Pride Corp. engages in the production, processing, marketing, and distribution of fresh, frozen and value-added chicken and pork products to retailers, distributors, and foodservice operators. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Europe, and Mexico. The company was founded by Lonnie A. Pilgrim and Aubrey Pilgrim on October 2, 1946, and is headquartered in Greeley, CO.
info.description_zh: Pilgrim's Pride Corp. 從事新鮮、冷凍和加值雞肉和豬肉產品的生產、加工、行銷和分銷給零售商、分銷​​商和餐飲服務業者。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲和墨西哥。該公司由 Lonnie A. Pilgrim 和 Aubrey Pilgrim 於 1946 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州格里利。

info.description: Versamet Royalties Corp. engages in the business of acquiring and managing royalties, streams, and other similar interests on metals and mining operations and projects globally. It focuses on precious metals, copper, and other diversified metals. Its portfolio includes the Kolpa, Kiaka, and Greenstone projects. The company was founded on January 31, 2022 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Versamet Royalties Corp. 從事收購和管理全球金屬和採礦業務及專案的特許權使用費、資源和其他類似權益的業務。它專注於貴金屬、銅和其他多元化金屬。其投資組合包括 Kolpa、Kiaka 和 Greenstone 項目。該公司成立於2022年1月31日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Leishen Energy Holding Co., Ltd. is engaged in the oil and gas industry. It operates through the following business segments; Clean-Energy Equipment; Oil and Gas Engineering Technical Services; New Energy Production and Operation; and Digitalization and Integration Equipment. The Clean-Energy Equipment segment supplies wellhead heating systems, wellhead safety control systems, oil-water separation systems, natural gas online sampling systems, oil and gas skid-mounted equipment and polymer flexible composite pipes. The Oil and Gas Engineering Technical Services segment provides technical solutions for oil and gas production. The New Energy Production and Operation segment focuses on the production, storage and transportation of natural gas, traditional fuels, development of distributed energy, and the planning and operation of new energy and new energy industries. The Digitalization and Integration Equipment segment is designed to provide informatization solutions for industrial intelligence, mobility, industrial interconnection and big data trends. The company was founded by Hongqi Li in 2007 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: 雷神能源控股股份有限公司從事石油和天然氣行業。它透過以下業務部門運作；清潔能源設備；石油天然氣工程技術服務；新能源生產經營；以及數位化和整合設備。清潔能源設備部門提供井口加熱系統、井口安全控制系統、油水分離系統、天然氣線上採樣系統、油氣撬裝設備和聚合物柔性複合管。油氣工程技術服務部門為油氣生產提供技術解決方案。新能源生產營運板塊專注於天然氣、傳統燃料的生產、儲運、分散式能源開發以及新能源及新能源產業的規劃與營運。數位化及整合設備板塊旨在為工業智慧化、行動化、工業互聯和大數據趨勢提供資訊化解決方案。該公司由李紅旗於2007年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Freenome, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company. It engages in the development of an early cancer detection platform. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Freenome, Inc. 是一家生技公司。它從事早期癌症檢測平台的開發。該公司成立於2014年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Krispy Kreme, Inc. produces and distributes doughnuts. It offers yeast-raised doughnuts, pies, coffees and espresso drinks, chillers and iced beverages. It operates through the following segments: U.S. and Canada, International, and Market Development. The U.S. and Canada segment includes all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the U.S. and Canada, Insomnia-branded retail shops and consumer packaged goods operations. The International segment consists of all Krispy Kreme's company-owned operations in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, and Mexico. The Market Development segment handles the franchise operations across the globe, as well as Krispy Kreme company-owned shops in Japan. The firm sells its products through mass merchant, grocery and convenience stores. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Krispy Kreme, Inc. 生產和分銷甜甜圈。它提供酵母甜甜圈、餡餅、咖啡和濃縮咖啡、冰鎮飲料和冰鎮飲料。它透過以下部門運作：美國和加拿大部門、國際部門和市場開發部門。美國和加拿大部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在美國和加拿大的所有業務、Insomnia 品牌零售店和消費品業務。國際部門包括 Krispy Kreme 公司在英國、愛爾蘭、澳洲、紐西蘭和墨西哥的所有業務。市場開發部門負責全球範圍內的特許經營業務以及 Krispy Kreme 公司在日本的自營商店。該公司透過大型商家、雜貨店和便利商店銷售其產品。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Imperial Petroleum, Inc. is a ship-owning company, which engages in the provision of petroleum products and crude oil seaborne transportation services. It offers international seaborne transportation services to oil producers, refineries, and commodities traders. The company has a fleet of three medium range product tankers that carry refined petroleum products, such as gasoline, diesel, fuel oil and jet fuel, as well as edible oils and chemicals, and one Aframax tanker, which is used for carrying crude oil. Imperial Petroleum was founded on May 14, 2021 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
info.description_zh: Imperial Petroleum, Inc.是一家船舶公司，從事提供石油產品和原油海運服務。它為石油生產商、煉油廠和大宗商品貿易商提供國際海運服務。該公司擁有一支由三艘中程成品油輪組成的船隊，運載汽油、柴油、燃料油和噴射燃料等精煉石油產品，以及食用油和化學品，以及一艘用於運載原油的阿芙拉型油輪。帝國石油成立於2021年5月14日，總部位於希臘雅典。

info.description: Diamondback Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil, and natural gas reserves. It operates through the Upstream and Midstream Services segments. The Upstream segment focuses on the Permian Basin operations in West Texas. The Midstream Services segment is involved in the Midland and Delaware Basins. The company was founded in December 2007 and is headquartered in Midland, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Diamondback Energy, Inc. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil, and natural gas reserves.它透過上游和中游服務部門運作。上游部門專注於德克薩斯州西部的二疊紀盆地業務。中游服務部門涉及米德蘭和特拉華盆地。該公司成立於2007年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州米德蘭。

info.description: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance, Inc. is a commercial mortgage real estate investment trust. It engages in a series of transactions of senior secured loans and other real estate related assets. The company was founded on March 30, 2021 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 抵押貸款
info.description_zh: 芝加哥大西洋房地產金融公司是一家商業抵押房地產投資信託公司。它從事一系列優先擔保貸款和其他房地產相關資產的交易。該公司成立於2021年3月30日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: First Trust Indxx Global Agriculture ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Indxx Global Agriculture Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is a market capitalization weighted index designed to measure the performance of companies that are directly or indirectly engaged in improving agricultural yields. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Indxx 全球農業 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Indxx 全球農業指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數是市值加權指數，旨在衡量直接或間接從事提高農業產量的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: IAC is a media and Internet company comprised of some of the world's most recognized brands and products, such as HomeAdvisor, Vimeo, About.com, Dictionary.com, The Daily Beast, Investopedia, and Match Group's online dating portfolio, which includes Match, OkCupid and Tinder. Ranked by Fortune magazine's annual standing of the world's most admired companies in the Internet Services & Retailing sector for many years, IAC's family of websites is one of the largest in the world, with over two billion monthly visits reaching users in more than 190 countries. The company is headquartered in the Chelsea neighborhood of New York City and has business operations and satellite offices around the world. In December 2004, Expedia split from IAC as a separate publicly traded company. In December 2011, TripAdvisor spun out from Expedia. In August 2008, IAC split into five separate publicly traded companies. The four spun-off companies were HSN, Ticketmaster, Interval Leisure Group, and Tree.com. IAC's notable acquisitions include: - 2012: [The About Group](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/about-com) - 2011: [OkCupid](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/okcupid) - 2011: [Meetic](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/meetic) - 2006: [Connected Ventures](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/connectedventures), the parent company of [CollegeHumor](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/collegehumor) - 2005: [Ask Jeeves](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/ask-com) - 2004: [TripAdvisor](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/tripadvisor) - 2003: LendingTree and remaining interest in Ticketmaster, Expedia and Hotels.com. - 2002: [Expedia](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/expedia) - 1999: [Match.com](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/match-com) - 1998: [Citysearch](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/citysearch)

info.description: Marvell Technology, Inc. engages in the design, development, and sale of integrated circuits. Its products include data processing units, security solutions, automotive, coherent DSP, DCI optical modules, ethernet controllers, ethernet PHYs, ethernet switches, linear driver, PAM DSP, transimpedance amplifiers, fibre channel, HDD, SSD controller, storage accelerators, ASIC, and Marvell government solutions. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Singapore, Israel, India, China, and Others. The company was founded by Wei Li Dai and Pantas Sutardja in 1995 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Marvell Technology, Inc. 從事積體電路的設計、開發和銷售。其產品包括資料處理單元、安全解決方案、汽車、相干 DSP、DCI 光學模組、乙太網路控制器、乙太網路 PHY、乙太網路交換器、線性驅動器、PAM DSP、互阻抗放大器、光纖通道、HDD、SSD 控制器、儲存加速器、ASIC 和 Marvell 政府解決方案。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、新加坡、以色列、印度、中國等。該公司由 Wei Li Dai 和 Pantas Sutardja 於 1995 年創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PBR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of PBR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PBR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PBR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PBR ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 PBR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable MSTR ETF is an income-generation strategy designed to distribute potential monthly coupons by investing in a rolling, laddered portfolio of single-stock autocallable option-linked derivatives. The fund manages positions through an ongoing rolling architecture targeting conditional yields and limited downside protection benchmarked strictly to the price action of an individual corporate reference equity.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable MSTR ETF 是一種創收策略，旨在透過投資滾動、階梯式的單股可自動贖回選擇權掛鉤衍生性商品投資組合來分配潛在的每月票面利率。該基金透過持續滾動架構管理頭寸，目標是有條件收益率和嚴格以個別公司參考股票的價格走勢為基準的有限下行保護。

info.description: Halliburton Co. engages in the provision of products and services to the energy industry. It operates through the Completion and Production, and Drilling and Evaluation segments. The Completion and Production segment focuses on cementing, stimulation, specialty chemicals, intervention, pressure control, artificial lift, and completion products and services. The Drilling and Evaluation segment provides field and reservoir modeling, drilling, fluids, evaluation, and wellbore placement solutions that enable customers to model, measure, drill, and optimize well construction activities. The company was founded by Erle P. Halliburton in 1919 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: 哈里伯頓公司從事為能源產業提供產品和服務。它透過完井和生產以及鑽井和評估部門運作。完井和生產部門專注於固井、增產、特殊化學品、幹預、壓力控制、人工舉升以及完井產品和服務。鑽井和評估部門提供現場和油藏建模、鑽井、流體、評估和井眼佈置解決方案，使客戶能夠建模、測量、鑽井和優化建井活動。該公司由 Erle P. Halliburton 於 1919 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: Oramed Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the provision of oral delivery solutions for drugs delivered via injection. It concentrates on the research and development of pharmaceutical solutions, including an oral insulin capsule to be used for the treatment of individuals with diabetes, and the use of orally ingestible capsules or pills for delivery of other polypeptides. The company was founded by Nadav Kidron and Miriam Kidron on April 12, 2002 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Oramed Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 致力於為注射藥物提供口服給藥解決方案。它專注於藥物解決方案的研究和開發，包括用於治療糖尿病患者的口服胰島素膠囊，以及使用口服膠囊或藥丸來輸送其他多肽。該公司由 Nadav Kidron 和 Miriam Kidron 於 2002 年 4 月 12 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Alpha Architect High Inflation And Deflation ETF seeks long-term total return. The fund primarily invests its assets in the shares of registered investment companies, including affiliated and non-affiliated ETFs, that emphasize investments in (i) intermediate-term U.S. Treasury bonds; (ii) real estate; and (iii) commodities. The Advisor expects to obtain its exposure to the Target Asset Classes primarily through its investments in underlying funds, but the fund also may invest directly in equity interests in real estate investment trusts (REITs) and in intermediate-term U.S. Treasury bonds. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect 高通膨和通貨緊縮 ETF 尋求長期總回報。該基金主要將其資產投資於註冊投資公司的股票，包括附屬和非附屬ETF，重點投資於(i) 中期美國國債； (ii) 房地產； (iii) 商品。顧問預計主要透過對基礎基金的投資來獲得對目標資產類別的投資，但該基金也可能直接投資於房地產投資信託基金 (REIT) 和中期美國國債的股權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Targa Resources Corp. engages in the business of gathering, compressing, treating, processing, transporting, and purchasing and selling natural gas. It operates through the following segments: Gathering and Processing, and Logistics and Transportation, and Other. The Gathering and Processing segment includes assets used in the gathering, and purchase and sale of natural gas produced from oil and gas wells. The Logistics and Transportation segment refers to the activities and assets necessary to convert mixed natural gas liquids (NGLs) into NGL products. The Other contains the results of commodity derivative activity mark-to-market gains and losses related to derivative contracts. The company was founded on October 27, 2005 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Targa Resources Corp. 從事天然氣採集、壓縮、處理、加工、運輸以及採購和銷售業務。它透過以下部門運作：收集和加工部門、物流和運輸部門以及其他部門。收集和加工部門包括用於收集、購買和銷售石油和天然氣井生產的天然氣的資產。物流和運輸部門是指將混合天然氣液體（NGL）轉化為 NGL 產品所需的活動和資產。其他包含與衍生性商品合約相關的商品衍生性商品活動以市價計價的損益結果。該公司成立於2005年10月27日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Tuttle Capital Daily 2X Inverse Regional Banks ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of the KRE ETF. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests in swap agreements that provide 200% inverse (opposite) daily exposure to TSLA equal to at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes ). The fund advisor seeks daily leveraged inverse investment results and the fund is very different from most other exchange-traded funds and presents different and greater risks. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tuttle Capital Daily 2X Inverse Regional Banks ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 KRE ETF 每日表現的 200% 倒數（或相反）。在正常情況下，該基金投資於掉期協議，該協議提供 200% 的 TSLA 每日反向（相反）敞口，相當於該基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）的至少 80%。基金顧問尋求每日槓桿反向投資結果，該基金與大多數其他交易所交易基金有很大不同，並呈現不同且更大的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: American Bitcoin Corp. engages in the management of a bitcoin accumulation platform. It offers exposure to bitcoin through an industry-first business model that integrates scaled self-mining operations with disciplined accumulation strategies. The company was founded by Eric Trump and Donald John Trump Jr. on October 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: 美國比特幣公司從事比特幣累積平台的管理。它透過行業首創的商業模式提供比特幣投資，該商業模式將規模化的自挖礦業務與嚴格的積累策略相結合。該公司由埃里克·川普和小唐納德·約翰·川普於2018年10月3日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Plains GP Holdings LP owns and operates midstream energy infrastructure and provides logistics services primarily for crude oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas through its indirect investment in Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. The firm operates through the following segments: Transportation, Facilities and Supply and Logistics. The Transportation segment consists of fee-based activities associated with transporting crude oil and NGL on pipelines, gathering systems, trucks and barges. The Facilities segment consists of fee-based activities associated with providing storage, terminalling and throughput services primarily for crude oil, NGL and natural gas, as well as NGL fractionation and isomerization services and natural gas and condensate processing services. The Supply and Logistics segment consists of storage of inventory during contango market conditions and the seasonal storage of NGL, purchase of NGL from producers, refiners, processors and other marketers, extraction of NGL from gas processed at the facilities. The company was founded in July 2013 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Plains GP Holdings LP 擁有並經營中游能源基礎設施，並透過其對 Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. 的間接投資，主要為原油、液化天然氣和天然氣提供物流服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：運輸、設施、供應和物流。運輸部門包括與透過管道、收集系統、卡車和駁船運輸原油和液化天然氣相關的收費活動。設施部門包括與主要為原油、液化天然氣和天然氣提供儲存、終端和吞吐量服務相關的收費活動，以及液化天然氣分餾和異構化服務以及天然氣和凝析油加工服務。供應和物流部門包括在期貨溢價市場條件下儲存庫存以及液化天然氣的季節性儲存，從生產商、煉油商、加工商和其他營銷商購買液化天然氣，從設施加工的天然氣中提取液化天然氣。該公司成立於2013年7月，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Plains All American Pipeline LP engages in the operation of midstream energy infrastructure and provides logistics services for crude oil, natural gas liquids, and natural gas. It operates through the following business segments: Crude Oil and Natural Gas Liquids. The Crude Oil segment includes its crude oil pipelines, crude oil storage and marine terminals, and related crude oil marketing activities. The Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) segment refers to NGL pipelines, NGL storage, natural gas processing and NGL fractionation facilities, and related NGL marketing activities. The company was founded by Greg L. Armstrong in 1981 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Plains All American Pipeline LP 從事中游能源基礎設施運營，並為原油、液化天然氣和天然氣提供物流服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：原油和液化天然氣。原油部門包括原油管道、原油儲存和海運碼頭以及相關的原油行銷活動。液化天然氣（NGL）部門是指液化天然氣管道、液化天然氣儲存、天然氣加工和液化天然氣分餾設施以及相關液化天然氣行銷活動。該公司由 Greg L. Armstrong 於 1981 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Keurig Dr Pepper, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sales of non-alcoholic beverages. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Refreshment Beverages, U.S. Coffee, and International. The U.S. Refreshment Beverages segment manufactures and distributes beverage concentrates, syrups, and finished beverages including the brands Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, Snapple, A&W, 7UP, Sunkist soda, Squirt, Hawaiian Punch, Core Hydration, Bai, C4 Energy, Clamato, Evian, Yoo-Hoo, Big Red, and Vita Coco. The U.S. Coffee segment involves single serve brewers, specialty, hot and iced varieties, and ready-to-drink beverages. The International segment includes sales in Canada, Mexico, and other markets. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Frisco, TX.
info.description_zh: Keurig Dr Pepper, Inc. 從事非酒精飲料的製造、行銷、分銷和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：美國清涼飲料部門、美國咖啡部門和國際部門。美國清涼飲料部門生產和分銷濃縮飲料、糖漿和成品飲料，包括 Dr Pepper、Canada Dry、Mott's、Snapple、A&W、7UP、Sunkist 蘇打水、Squirt、Hawaiian Punch、Core Hydration、Bai、C4 Energy、Clamato、Evian、Yoo-Hoo、Big Red 和 Cococo 等品牌。美國咖啡部門涉及單杯咖啡、特色咖啡、熱飲和冰飲以及即飲飲料。國際部門包括加拿大、墨西哥和其他市場的銷售。該公司成立於 2018 年，總部位於德克薩斯州弗里斯科。

info.description: Tesla, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems. It operates through the Automotive and Energy Generation and Storage segments. The Automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacture, sale, and lease of electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. The Energy Generation and Storage segment is involved in the design, manufacture, installation, sale, and lease of solar energy generation, energy storage products, and related services and sales of solar energy systems incentives. The company was founded by Jeffrey B. Straubel, Elon Reeve Musk, Martin Eberhard, and Marc Tarpenning on July 1, 2003 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Tesla, Inc. 從事電動車以及能源產生和儲存系統的設計、開發、製造和銷售。它透過汽車、能源生產和儲存部門運作。汽車部門包括電動車的設計、開發、製造、銷售和租賃以及汽車監管積分的銷售。能源發電和儲存部門從事太陽能發電、儲能產品的設計、製造、安裝、銷售和租賃，以及太陽能係統激勵措施的相關服務和銷售。該公司由 Jeffrey B. Straubel、Elon Reeve Musk、Martin Eberhard 和 Marc Tarpenning 於 2003 年 7 月 1 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Deere & Co. engages in the manufacture and distribution of equipment used in agriculture, construction, forestry, and turf care. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture and Turf, Construction and Forestry, and Financial Services. The Agriculture and Turf segment focuses on the distribution and manufacture of a full line of agriculture and turf equipment and related service parts. The Construction and Forestry segment offers machines and service parts used in construction, earthmoving, road building, material handling and timber harvesting. The Financial Services segment finances sales and leases by John Deere dealers of new and used agriculture and turf equipment and construction and forestry equipment. The company was founded by John Deere in 1837 and is headquartered in Moline, IL.

info.description_zh: Deere & Co. 從事農業、建築、林業和草坪護理設備的製造和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：農業和草坪部門、建築和林業部門以及金融服務部門。農業和草坪部門專注於全系列農業和草坪設備及相關服務零件的分銷和製造。建築和林業部門提供用於建築、土方工程、道路建設、材料處理和木材採伐的機器和服務零件。金融服務部門為約翰迪爾經銷商銷售和租賃新的和二手的農業和草坪設備以及建築和林業設備提供融資。該公司由約翰迪爾於 1837 年創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州莫林。

info.description: Sphere 3D Corp. is a bitcoin mining company. The firm is engaged in growing its digital asset mining operation through the capital-efficient procurement of next-generation mining equipment and partnering with data center operators. Its bitcoin mining business segment involves acquiring computer servers, which operate application-specific integrated circuit chips designed specifically to mine bitcoin, and deploy, such miners at-scale utilizing its hosting agreements. The company was founded on May 2, 2007 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Sphere 3D Corp. 是一家比特幣挖礦公司。該公司致力於透過資本高效的下一代採礦設備採購以及與資料中心營運商合作來發展其數位資產採礦業務。其比特幣挖礦業務部門涉及收購電腦伺服器，這些伺服器運行專門為挖掘比特幣而設計的專用集成電路晶片，並利用其託管協議大規模部署此類礦機。該公司成立於2007年5月2日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Bicycle Therapeutics Plc is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of a novel class of medicines, which the company refers to as bicycles, for diseases that are underserved by existing therapeutics. Its portfolio includes internal product candidates that are directed to oncology applications. The company was founded by Gregory Winter, John Tite, and Christian Heinis in 2009 and is headquartered in Cambridge, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Bicycle Therapeutics Plc 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發一類新型藥物，該公司稱之為“自行車”，用於治療現有療法治療不足的疾病。其產品組合包括針對腫瘤學應用的內部候選產品。該公司由 Gregory Winter、John Tite 和 Christian Heinis 於 2009 年創立，總部位於英國劍橋。

info.description: Baillie Gifford International Alpha ETF is an actively managed, unconstrained portfolio that invests in growth equities across developed and emerging markets, excluding the United States. Utilizing a research-driven, bottom-up fundamental selection process with a typical investment horizon of at least five years, the fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by targeting companies with strong structural advantages and distinct growth potential outside its primary benchmark, the MSCI ACWI ex USA Index.
info.description_zh: Baillie Gifford International Alpha ETF 是一種主動管理、不受約束的投資組合，投資於已開發市場和新興市場（美國除外）的成長型股票。該基金採用研究驅動、自下而上的基本面選擇流程，典型投資期限至少為五年，透過瞄準在其主要基準 MSCI ACWI（美國除外）指數之外具有強大結構優勢和明顯增長潛力的公司來尋求長期資本增值。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Biotech ETF is designed to maximize weekly income by executing an options strategy focused primarily on selling short-term put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds that track the 3x daily performance of the biotechnology sector. The fund targets three times the income stream compared to standard options writing on its underlying industry exposure while providing capped secondary capital appreciation and implementing a discretionary downside protection layer.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 生物技術 ETF 旨在透過執行選擇策略來最大化每週收入，該策略主要側重於出售槓桿交易所交易基金的短期看跌期權，該基金追蹤生物技術行業 3 倍的每日表現。該基金的目標是其基礎產業曝險的收入流是標準選擇權的三倍，同時提供有上限的二次資本增值並實施酌情下行保護層。

info.description: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, which refer to throughout this prospectus as initial business combination. The company was founded on June 9, 2025 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。其成立的目的是与一个或多个企业进行合并、合并、股份交换、资产收购、股份购买、重组或类似的业务合并，在本招股说明书中将其称为初始业务合并。該公司成立於 2025 年 6 月 9 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Reliance Global Group, Inc. is a diversified company, which engages in the business of insurance market and other relates sectors. It focuses on acquisition strategy, wholesale, and retail insurance agencies. The company was founded on August 2, 2013 and is headquartered in Lakewood, NJ.
info.description_zh: Reliance Global Group, Inc.是一家多元化公司，從事保險市場及其他相關行業的業務。它專注於收購策略、批發和零售保險機構。該公司成立於2013年8月2日，總部位於新澤西州萊克伍德。

info.description: First Trust Alternative Absolute Return Strategy ETF seeks to provide investors with long-term total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve long-term total return through long and short investments in exchange-traded commodity futures contracts ("Commodity Futures") through a wholly-owned subsidiary of the fund organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands (the "Subsidiary"). It does not invest directly in Commodity Futures. The advisor gains exposure to these investments exclusively by investing in the Subsidiary. The Subsidiary is advised by First Trust Advisors L.P., the fund's investment advisor.
info.description_zh: First Trust Alternative絕對回報策略ETF旨在為投資者提供長期總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過該基金根據開曼群島法律組成的全資子公司（「子公司」）對交易所交易商品期貨合約（「商品期貨」）進行多頭和空頭投資，以實現長期總回報。它不會直接投資於商品期貨。顧問僅透過投資子公司來獲得這些投資的機會。該子公司由該基金的投資顧問 First Trust Advisors L.P. 提供諮詢服務。

info.description: Fidelity Managed Futurees ETF seeks capital appreciation. The und advisor seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by pursuing a strategy intended to capture the persistence of price trends observed across equity, fixed income, currency and commodity markets. The fund's investment strategy utilizes a combination of equity, fixed income, currency and commodity derivatives, as well as certain direct investments, to provide exposure to these markets and price trends. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description_zh: Funko, Inc. 從事設計、採購和分銷授權流行文化產品。其產品線包括媒體和娛樂內容，包括電影、電視節目、電玩、音樂和體育。它透過美國、歐洲和其他國際地理區域開展業務。該公司成立於 1998 年，總部位於華盛頓州埃弗里特。

info.description: Eva Live, Inc. engages in the entertainment, publishing, and interactive industries through its subsidiaries. Its operations include motion picture production, acquisition, and distribution, television production, acquisition, and distribution, digital content creation and distribution, and development of new entertainment products, services, and technologies on various platforms. The company was founded by David Boulette on August 27, 2002 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Eva Live, Inc. 透過其子公司從事娛樂、出版和互動產業。其業務包括電影製作、收購和發行、電視製作、收購和發行、數位內容創作和發行，以及在各種平台上開發新的娛樂產品、服務和技術。該公司由 David Boulette 於 2002 年 8 月 27 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HIMS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Hims & Hers Health, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description_zh: Iron Horse Acquisition II Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 11 月 26 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Lumexa Imaging Holdings, Inc. engages in providing diagnostic imaging services. It focuses on its teleradiology platform, Connexia. It operates through the Outpatient Imaging Centers (Outpatient) and Professional Services (Professional) segments. The Outpatient segment performs imaging studies and provides radiologists' interpretations of those studies. The Professional segment relates to the interpretation of imaging studies. The company was founded on November 14, 2025 and is headquartered in NC, Raleigh.
info.description_zh: Lumexa Imaging Holdings, Inc. 從事提供診斷影像服務。它專注於其遠端放射學平台 Connexia。它透過門診影像中心（門診）和專業服務（專業）部門運作。門診部分進行影像學研究並提供放射科醫師對這些研究的解釋。專業部分涉及影像研究的解釋。該公司成立於2025年11月14日，總部位於北卡羅來納州羅利。

info.description: Methanex Corp. engages in the production and supply of methanol. The firm supplies in the international markets such as North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, and South America. It also operates the methanol ocean tanker fleet. The company was founded on March 11, 1968 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Macetex Corp. 從事甲醇的生產和供應。該公司向北美、亞太地區、歐洲和南美等國際市場供貨。它還經營甲醇遠洋油輪船隊。該公司成立於1968年3月11日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Marker Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of novel cell-based immunotherapies and peptide-based vaccines for the treatment of hematological malignancies and solid tumor indications. The company was founded on October 22, 1991 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Marker Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的免疫腫瘤公司，致力於新型細胞免疫療法和勝肽疫苗的開發和商業化，用於治療血液惡性腫瘤和實體瘤適應症。該公司成立於1991年10月22日，總部位於德州休士頓。

The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Micron Technology, Inc. (MU). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.

info.description: Nkarta, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of natural killer cell therapies for the treatment of cancer. info.description_zh: Nkarta, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於癌症治療的自然殺手細胞療法的發現、開發和商業化。該公司的產品包括NKX101和NKX019，NKX101處於I期臨床試驗中，用於治療復發/難治性急性髓性白血病或高風險骨髓增生異常綜合徵，NKX019是一種臨床前產品，其基於通過靶向這些類型的癌細胞上發現的CD19抗原來治療各種B細胞惡性腫瘤的能力。該公司由 Dario Campana 於 2005 年創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Rivian Automotive, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of category-defining electric vehicles and accessories. It operates through following segments: Automotive, Software and Services. The company was founded by Robert J. Scaringe in June 2009 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Rivian Automotive, Inc. 從事定義類別的電動車及配件的設計、開發和製造。它透過以下部門運作：汽車部門、軟體部門和服務部門。該公司由 Robert J. Scaringe 於 2009 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that combines automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and in vivo validation capabilities to discover novel medicines. Its Recursion operating system enables advanced machine learning approaches to reveal drug candidates, mechanisms of action, novel chemistry, and potential toxicity, with the eventual goal of decoding biology and advancing new therapeutics that radically improve people's lives. The company was founded by Blake Borgeson, Christopher C. Gibson, and Dean Y. Li on November 4, 2013 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，結合自動化、人工智慧、機器學習和體內驗證能力來發現新藥。其遞歸操作系統使先進的機器學習方法能夠揭示候選藥物、作用機制、新穎的化學物質和潛在的毒性，最終目標是解碼生物學並推進新的治療方法，從根本上改善人們的生活。該公司由 Blake Borgeson、Christopher C. Gibson 和 Dean Y. Li 於 2013 年 11 月 4 日創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: SNDL, Inc. is a licensed producer that crafts small-batch cannabis using state-of-the-art indoor facilities. It operates through the following segments: Liquor Retail, Cannabis Retail, Cannabis Operations, and Investments. The Liquor Retail segment consists of wines, beers, and spirits through owned liquor stores. The Cannabis Retail segment comprises of the private sale of adult-use cannabis through owned and franchise retail cannabis stores. The Cannabis Operations covers the cultivation, distribution and sale of cannabis for the adult-use, and medical markets domestically and for export. The Investments segment includes the deployment of capital to investment opportunities. The company was founded by Stanley J. Swiatek on August 19, 2006 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: SNDL, Inc. 是一家獲得許可的生產商，使用最先進的室內設施生產小批量大麻。它透過以下部門運作：酒類零售、大麻零售、大麻營運和投資。酒類零售部門透過自有酒類商店銷售葡萄酒、啤酒和烈酒。大麻零售部門包括透過自營和特許零售大麻商店私人銷售成人用大麻。大麻業務涵蓋供成人使用以及國內和出口醫療市場使用的大麻的種植、分銷和銷售。投資部門包括將資本部署到投資機會。該公司由Stanley J. Swiatek於2006年8月19日創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SOFI ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of SoFi Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: SOFI). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 SOFI ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 SoFi Technologies, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：SOFI）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SuperX AI Technology Ltd. engages in providing artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions. It offers integrated systems that include computation, model hosting, data pipelines, and orchestration tools to facilitate enterprise AI deployment on a global scale. The company was founded on August 25, 2021, and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: SuperX AI Technology Ltd. 致力於提供人工智慧基礎設施解決方案。它提供包括運算、模型託管、資料管道和編排工具的整合系統，以促進全球範圍內的企業人工智慧部署。該公司成立於2021年8月25日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: UP Fintech Holding Ltd. is an online brokerage firm that focuses on global investors. It provides an online trading platform that enables investors to trade in equities and other financial instruments on multiple exchanges around the world. The firm offers products and services, as well as a user experience to customers through its mobile first strategy. The company was founded by Tian Hua Wu in June 2014 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: UP Fintech Holding Ltd.是一家專注於全球投資者的線上經紀公司。它提供了一個線上交易平台，使投資者能夠在世界各地的多個交易所進行股票和其他金融工具的交易。該公司透過其行動優先策略為客戶提供產品和服務以及用戶體驗。該公司由吳天華於2014年6月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.25x Long Tsla Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.25 times (125%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Tesla Inc. The fund is an actively managed etf that attempts to replicate 1.25 times (125%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The adviser will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the adviser and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underling stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 1.25x Long Tsla Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，為特斯拉公司普通股每日百分比變化的 1.25 倍 (125%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 1.25 倍 (125%)。顧問將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，顧問和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSLA ETF seeks current income; the secondary investment objective being exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Tesla Inc. subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the underlying TSLA ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
