info.description: WeRide, Inc. operates as an investment holding company. It engages in the sale of autonomous driving vehicles, primarily including robobuses, robotaxis, robosweepers and related sensor suites. The company was founded by Tony Xu Han and Yan Li in February 2017 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 文遠知行文遠知行以投資控股公司經營。它從事自動駕駛車輛的銷售，主要包括機器人公車、機器人計程車、機器人掃地機和相關感測器套件。該公司由Tony Xu Han和Yan Li於2017年2月創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Ether ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a synthetic income-generation strategy by selling put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds linked to the daily performance of Ether. The fund seeks to achieve 200% of the income derived from standard option strategies on the reference asset while maintaining exposure to the underlying leveraged instrument, albeit constrained by a cap on potential capital appreciation.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 以太 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過出售與以太每日表現掛鉤的槓桿交易所交易基金看跌期權，採用合成創收策略。該基金力求實現參考資產的標準選擇權策略所產生的 200% 的收入，同時保持對基礎槓桿工具的曝險，儘管受到潛在資本增值上限的限制。

info.description: FortuneX Acquisition Corp is a blank check company. It was formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 16, 2026 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: FortuneX Acquisition Corp 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2026年2月16日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Invesco Agriculture Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to commodities drawn from the agriculture sector. It will not invest directly in physical commodities, Commodities Futures or Commodity-Linked Instruments. Instead, The Advisor attempts to obtain investment returns that are highly correlated to the agriculture commodities markets by investing in these instruments indirectly through its Subsidiary. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順農業商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過投資與農業部門商品經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。它不會直接投資於實體商品、商品期貨或商品相關工具。相反，顧問試圖透過其子公司間接投資於這些工具，以獲得與農產品市場高度相關的投資回報。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long DUOL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of DUOL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of DUOL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 DUOL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 DUOL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 DUOL 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Emmis Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Emmis Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年3月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: Vertex, Inc. engages in the provision of tax compliance software solutions. The firm offers comprehensive solutions that automate end-to-end indirect tax processes for enterprises and mid-market companies with complex tax transactions. Its software enables tax determination, data management, compliance and reporting, and document management. The company was founded by Ray Westphal and Antoinette Westphal in 1978 and is headquartered in King of Prussia, PA.
info.description_zh: Vertex, Inc. 從事提供稅務合規軟體解決方案。該公司提供全面的解決方案，為具有複雜稅務交易的企業和中型市場公司實現端到端間接稅務流程的自動化。其軟體支援稅務確定、資料管理、合規性和報告以及文件管理。該公司由 Ray Westphal 和 Antoinette Westphal 於 1978 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州普魯士國王。

info.description: Vanguard Core Bond ETF seeks to provide total return while generating a moderate level of income. The fund invests in fixed income securities of various maturities, yields, and qualities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds, which include fixed income securities such as corporate bonds; U.S. Treasury obligations and other U.S. government and agency securities; and asset-backed, mortgage-backed, and mortgage-related securities.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Core Bond ETF 尋求提供總回報，同時產生適度的收入水準。該基金投資於各種期限、收益率和品質的固定收益證券。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於債券，其中包括公司債等固定收益證券；美國財政部債務和其他美國政府和機構證券；以及資產支持、抵押貸款支持和抵押相關證券。

info.description: F/m Compoundr U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF seeks investment results, that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the Nasdaq Compoundr 10-Year U.S. Treasury Note Index. The index is designed to offer exposure consistent with the total return of U.S. investment-grade aggregate bonds, without receiving and reinvesting dividend income, by investing in ETFs. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments LLC (the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in underlying funds that primarily invest in U.S. dollar denominated investment-grade bonds.
info.description_zh: F/m 複合美國綜合債券 ETF 追求的投資結果通常與納斯達克複合 10 年期美國公債指數相對應（未計費用和開支）。該指數旨在透過投資 ETF 提供與美國投資等級總債券總回報一致的風險敞口，而無需接收股息收入並進行再投資。在正常市場條件下，F/m Investments LLC（「顧問」）尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於主要投資於以美元計價的投資級債券的基礎基金來實現基金的目標。

info.description: iShares MBS ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. MBS Index composed of investment-grade mortgage-backed pass-through securities issued and/or guaranteed by U.S. government agencies. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and TBAs that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares MBS ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國 MBS 指數的投資結果，該指數由美國政府機構發行和/或擔保的投資等級抵押貸款支持傳遞證券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及經濟特徵與該指數組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的 TBA，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金跟踪該指數的標的指數中包含的固定收益證券類型。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ex China ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets ex China Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that captures large- and mid-capitalization stocks across 23 of the 24 Emerging Markets countries, excluding China.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新兴市场（中国除外）ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场（中国除外）指数（“基础指数”）的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，涵蓋 24 個新興市場國家中 23 個國家（不包括中國）的大中型股票。

info.description: Vanguard Mortgage-Backed Securities Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted mortgage-backed securities index. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. MBS Float Adjusted Index. This index covers U.S. agency mortgage-backed pass-through securities issued by the GNMA, the FNMA, and the FHLMC. To be included in the index, pool aggregates must have at least $1 billion currently outstanding and a weighted average maturity of at least 1 year. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard 抵押貸款支持證券指數基金 ETF 股票旨在追蹤市場加權抵押貸款支持證券指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國MBS浮動調整指數的表現。該指數涵蓋 GNMA、FNMA 和 FHLMC 發行的美國機構抵押貸款支持傳遞證券。要納入該指數，資金池總計必須擁有至少 10 億美元的當前未償還資金，且加權平均期限至少為 1 年。基金的所有投資將透過抽樣過程進行篩選，基金資產的至少80%將投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Choice ESG Screened 5% Issuer Capped Index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization emerging market companies with favorable ESG ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場選擇 ESG 篩選 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 評級的大中型新興市場公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於指數成分證券以及與指數成分證券具有基本相同經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Janux Therapeutics, Inc. operates a preclinical stage biopharmaceutical company which engages in developing therapeutics based on the Tumor Activated T Cell Engager platform technology. The company was founded by David Campbell in June 2017 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Janux Therapeutics, Inc. 經營一家臨床前階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發基於腫瘤活化 T 細胞接合器平台技術的療法。該公司由 David Campbell 於 2017 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: LKQ Corp. engages in the distribution of vehicle products and its parts to repair, maintain, and accessorize automobiles. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale-North America, Europe, and Specialty. The Wholesale-North America segment consists of aftermarket and salvage operations and sells five product types to professional collision and mechanical vehicle repair businesses. The Europe segment offers aftermarket operations. The Specialty segment distributes specialty vehicle aftermarket products and accessories in North America. The company was founded by Donald F. Flynn on February 13, 1998 and is headquartered in Antioch, TN.
info.description_zh: LKQ Corp. 從事汽車產品及其零件的分銷，以維修、保養和裝飾汽車。它透過以下部門運作：北美批發部門、歐洲部門和專業部門。北美批發部門包括售後市場和救助業務，並向專業碰撞和機械車輛維修企業銷售五種產品類型。歐洲部門提供售後業務。特種車輛部門在北美分銷特種車輛售後市場產品和配件。該公司由 Donald F. Flynn 於 1998 年 2 月 13 日創立，總部位於田納西州安提阿。

info.description: Compugen Ltd. engages in the research, development, and commercialization of therapeutic and diagnostic biomarker product candidates including proteins and monoclonal antibodies. It focuses on research and development on immuno-oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded by Eli Mintz, Simchon Faigler, and Amir Natan on February 10, 1993 and is headquartered in Holon, Israel.
info.description_zh: Compugen Ltd. 從事治療和診斷生物標記候選產品（包括蛋白質和單株抗體）的研究、開發和商業化。它專注於免疫腫瘤學和自體免疫疾病的研究和開發。該公司由 Eli Mintz、Simchon Faigler 和 Amir Natan 於 1993 年 2 月 10 日創立，總部位於以色列霍隆。

info.description: Newmark Group, Inc. engages in the provision of commercial real estate services. It offers its services to commercial real estate tenants, investors, owners, occupiers, developers, leasing and corporate advisory, investment sales and real estate finance, consulting, origination and servicing of commercial mortgage loans, valuation, project and development management and property and facility management. The company was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Newmark Group, Inc. 從事提供商業房地產服務。它為商業房地產租戶、投資者、業主、佔用者、開發商、租賃和企業諮詢、投資銷售和房地產金融、商業抵押貸款的諮詢、發放和服務、評估、專案和開發管理以及財產和設施管理提供服務。該公司成立於 1929 年，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: F/m Emerald Life Sciences Innovation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") and invests primarily in equity securities of life science companies selected by Emerald Mutual Fund Advisers Trust, the fund's investment sub-adviser, under the supervision of the adviser. Under normal market conditions, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities issued by life science companies demonstrating innovation.
info.description_zh: F/m Emerald Life Sciences Innovation ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於該基金的投資副顧問 Emerald Mutual Fund Advisers Trust 選擇的生命科學公司的股本證券，並接受顧問的監督。在正常市場條件下，該基金至少80%的淨資產投資於具有創新能力的生命科學公司發行的股本證券。

info.description: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 100% of the inverse (or opposite) of the daily performance of AVGO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments, including swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 1X daily inverse (opposite) or short exposure to AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AVGO Bear 1X Shares 寻求与 AVGO 每日表现相反（或相反）的 100% 的每日投资结果（扣除费用和开支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於金融工具，包括掉期協議和選擇權，這些金融工具結合起來提供 1 倍的每日反向（相反）或空頭敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cabaletta Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of engineered T cell therapies for B cell-mediated autoimmune diseases. Its proprietary technology utilizes chimeric autoantibody receptor to selectively bind and eliminate B cells that produce disease-causing autoantibodies. The company was founded by Michael C. Milone, Steven Nichtberger, and Aimee Payne in April 2017 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Cabaletta Bio, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發針對 B 細胞介導的自身免疫性疾病的工程 T 細胞療法。其專有技術可利用嵌合自體抗體受體選擇性結合並消除產生致病自體抗體的 B 細胞。該公司由 Michael C. Milone、Steven Nichtberger 和 Aimee Payne 於 2017 年 4 月創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: Eli Lilly & Co. engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceutical products. The firm's products include diabetes, oncology, immunology, neuroscience, and other products and therapies. The company was founded by Eli Lilly on May 10, 1876 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: 禮來公司 (Eli Lilly & Co.) 從事醫藥產品的發現、開發、製造和銷售。該公司的產品包括糖尿病、腫瘤學、免疫學、神經科學以及其他產品和療法。該公司由禮來公司於 1876 年 5 月 10 日創立，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: AIR Global Plc engages in the provision of branded flavored molasses (commonly known as "hookah", "shisha" or "mu'assel"), a tobacco-based mixture that is commonly around 15% to 25% tobacco by weight and typically inhaled via a water pipe. It operates through the following segments: Core-Americas, Core-Europe, Core-Middle East, Africa, and Asia (MEAA), and New Growth Categories. The Core-Americas segment Includes the production and sale of traditional shisha tobacco and other non-New Growth Categories ("non-NGC") brands, distributed in the Americas through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. The Core-Europe segment refers to the production and sale of traditional shisha tobacco under the Al Fakher and other non-NGC brands, distributed throughout Europe through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. The Core-Middle East, Africa, and Asia segment focuses on the the production and sale of traditional shisha tobacco under the Al Fakher and other non-NGC brands, distributed throughout the Middle East through wholesale, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels. The New Growth Categories segment covers the Group's offering under the OOKA brand (including proprietary devices and related consumables), modern oral nicotine pouches, and both nicotine and non-nicotine inhalation devices under the VANT and Crown Switch brands. The company was founded on October 28, 2025 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
info.description_zh: AIR Global Plc 從事品牌風味糖蜜（通常稱為「水煙」、「水煙」或「mu'assel」）的供應，這是一種基於菸草的混合物，通常含有約 15% 至 25% 的菸草重量，通常透過水管吸入。它透過以下部門運作：核心美洲部門、核心歐洲部門、核心中東、非洲和亞洲部門 (MEAA) 以及新增長類別部門。核心美洲部門包括傳統水煙菸草和其他非新增長類別（「非NGC」）品牌的生產和銷售，透過批發、零售和直接面向消費者的管道在美洲分銷。核心歐洲部門是指生產和銷售 Al Fakher 和其他非 NGC 品牌的傳統水煙，透過批發、零售和直接面向消費者的管道分銷到整個歐洲。核心中東、非洲和亞洲部門專注於生產和銷售 Al Fakher 和其他非 NGC 品牌的傳統水煙，透過批發、零售和直接面向消費者的管道分銷到整個中東地區。新成長類別部門涵蓋集團以 OOKA 品牌提供的產品（包括專有設備和相關消耗品）、現代口服尼古丁袋，以及 VANT 和 Crown Switch 品牌下的尼古丁和非尼古丁吸入設備。該公司成立於2025年10月28日，總部位於阿拉伯聯合大公國杜拜。

info.description: Biogen, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovering, developing, and delivering therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases. Its products include TECFIDERA, VUMERITY, AVONEX, PLEGRIDY, TYSABRI, and FAMPYRA for the treatment of MS, SPINRAZA for the treatment of SMA, ADUHELM for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, and FUMADERM for the treatment of severe plaque psoriasis. The company was founded by Charles Weissmann, Heinz Schaller, Kenneth Murray, Walter Gilbert, and Phillip Allen Sharp in 1978 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Biogen, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和提供神經系統和神經退化性疾病的治療方法。其產品包括用於治療多發性硬化症的TECFIDERA、VUMERITY、AVONEX、PLEGRIDY、TYSABRI和FAMPYRA，用於治療SMA的SPINRAZA，用於治療阿茲海默症的ADUHELM，以及用於治療嚴重斑塊狀乾癬的FUMADERM。該公司由 Charles Weissmann、Heinz Schaller、Kenneth Murray、Walter Gilbert 和 Phillip Allen Sharp 於 1978 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Roivant Sciences Ltd. engages in the biopharmaceutical business, which engages in the development of transformative medicine. Its product portfolio includes Vtama, Batoclimab, Brepocitinib, Namilumab, and RVT-2001, which aims to treat psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, thyroid eye disease, and other illnesses. The company was founded by Vivek Ramaswamy on April 7, 2014 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Roivant Sciences Ltd.從事生物製藥業務，致力於變革醫學的開發。其產品組合包括 Vtama、Batoclimab、Brepocitinib、Namilumab 和 RVT-2001，旨在治療牛皮癬、異位性皮膚炎、甲狀腺眼疾和其他疾病。該公司由Vivek Ramaswamy於2014年4月7日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the IPOX  International Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is a market-cap weighted portfolio measuring the performance of the top 50 companies domiciled outside the United States ranked quarterly by market capitalization in the IPOX  Global Composite Index and represents, on average, 25% of the total market capitalization of the base index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 IPOX International Index 的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數是一個市值加權投資組合，衡量美國境外註冊的前 50 名公司的業績，按季度在 IPOX 全球綜合指數中的市值排名，平均佔基礎指數總市值的 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Adicet Bio, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in discovering and developing allogeneic gamma delta T cell therapies for cancer. It also focuses on developing a pipeline of "off-the-shelf" gamma delta T cells. The company was founded by Aya Jakobovits in November 2014 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Adicet Bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發癌症同種異體 γ δ T 細胞療法。它還專注於開發一系列「現成」的 γ δ T 細胞。該公司由 Aya Jakobovits 於 2014 年 11 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical stage bio-pharmaceutical company, which engages in the research, development, and commercialization of therapeutic drugs. The company was founded by Robert Foster, Richard Glickman, and Michael Martin on June 16, 1993 and is headquartered in Edmonton, Canada.
info.description_zh: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，從事治療藥物的研究、開發和商業化。該公司由 Robert Foster、Richard Glickman 和 Michael Martin 於 1993 年 6 月 16 日創立，總部位於加拿大埃德蒙頓。

info.description: ALPS Electrification Infrastructure ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the performance of the Ladenburg Thalmann Electrification Infrastructure Index. The underlying index utilizes a proprietary, rules-based methodology developed by Ladenburg Thalmann Index, LLC (the "index provider"), which is designed to measure the performance of publicly-listed large-capitalization and mid-capitalization companies that are positioned to benefit from "electrification". The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in securities that comprise the underlying index.
info.description_zh: ALPS 電氣化基礎設施 ETF 尋求與 Ladenburg Thalmann 電氣化基礎設施指數表現大致相符的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。基礎指數採用由 Ladenburg Thalmann Index, LLC（「指數提供者」）開發的專有的、基於規則的方法，旨在衡量那些有望從「電氣化」中受益的上市大市值和中市值公司的業績。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於構成基礎指數的證券。

info.description: Nanobiotix SA is a late-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of therapeutic approaches to the treatment of cancer. Its technologies include NanoXray that improves the efficacy of radiation therapy against tumor cells. The company was founded by Laurent Levy and Abdel Kader Boussaha on March 4, 2003 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
info.description_zh: Nanobiotix SA 是一家後期生物技術公司，致力於開發癌症治療方法。其技術包括 NanoXray，可提高放射治療對腫瘤細胞的功效。該公司由Laurent Levy和Abdel Kader Boussaha於2003年3月4日創立，總部位於法國巴黎。

info.description: Heritage Global, Inc. engages in the provision of corporate and financial asset liquidation transactions, valuations, and advisory services. It operates through the following segments: Auction and Liquidation, Refurbishment and Resale, Brokerage, and Specialty Lending. The Auction and Liquidation segment focuses on operating a global full-service auction, appraisal, and asset advisory firm, including the acquisition of turnkey manufacturing facilities and used industrial machinery and equipment. The Refurbishment and Resale segment acquires, refurbishes, and supplies specialized laboratory equipment. The Brokerage segment manages charged-off receivables in the U.S. and Canada on behalf of financial institutions. The Specialty Lending segment provides specialty financing solutions to investors in charged-off and non-performing asset portfolios. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Heritage Global, Inc. 從事提供企業和金融資產清算交易、估值和諮詢服務。它透過以下部門運作：拍賣和清算、翻新和轉售、經紀和專業貸款。拍賣和清算部門​​專注於經營一家全球全方位服務拍賣、評估和資產諮詢公司，包括收購交鑰匙製造設施和二手工業機械和設備。翻新和轉售部門收購、翻新和供應專業實驗室設備。經紀部門代表金融機構管理美國和加拿大的應收帳款。專業貸款部門為沖銷和不良資產組合的投資者提供專業融資解決方案。該公司成立於 1937 年，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Prime Medicine, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in developing one-time curative genetic therapies. The company was founded by David R. Liu on September 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Prime Medicine, Inc. 是一家生技公司，致力於開發一次性治療性基因療法。該公司由 David R. Liu 於 2019 年 9 月 13 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Solid Biosciences, Inc. is a life science company, which engages in the development of treatments for patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. It also focuses on developing treatments for neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Ilan Ganot, Andrey J. Zarur, Matthew Bennett Arnold, Annie Ganot, and Gilad David Hayeem in March 2013 and is headquartered in Charlestown, MA.
info.description_zh: Solid Biosciences, Inc.是一家生命科學公司，致力於開發杜氏肌肉營養不良症患者的治療方法。它還專注於開發神經肌肉和心臟病的治療方法。該公司由 Ilan Ganot、Andrey J. Zarur、Matthew Bennett Arnold、Annie Ganot 和 Gilad David Hayeem 於 2013 年 3 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州查爾斯敦。

info.description: Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Global X AI Semiconductor & Quantum Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities of the underlying index), which may include common stocks, ADRs and GDRs. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of companies that are involved in the artificial intelligence ("AI") semiconductor and quantum computing ecosystems. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X AI 半導體和量子 ETF 力求提供與 Global X AI 半導體和量子指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於相關指數的證券，其中可能包括普通股、ADR 和 GDR。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤參與人工智慧（「AI」）半導體和量子運算生態系統的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 100 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 1,000 securities of the largest constituents by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index 的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由約 100 檔證券組成，這些證券來自納斯達克美國基準指數中市值最大的成分股的約 1,000 只合格證券。

info.description: Iron Mountain, Inc. engages in the provision of storage and information management solutions. It operates through the following business segments: Global Records & Information Management Business, Global Data Center Business and Corporate & Other Business. The Global Records & Information Management Business segment offers comprehensive solutions for storing, managing, digitizing, and securely disposing of records and information worldwide. The Global Data Center Business segment provides data center facilities to protect mission-critical assets and ensure the continued operation of its customers IT infrastructures, with secure and reliable colocation and wholesale options. The Corporate & Other Business segment consists of the storage, safeguarding and electronic or physical deliveries of physical media of all types and digital content repository systems to house, distribute, and archive key media assets, primarily for entertainment and media industry clients. The company was founded by Herman Knaust in 1951 and is headquartered in Portsmouth, NH.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Iron Mountain, Inc. 從事提供儲存和資訊管理解決方案。它透過以下業務部門運作：全球記錄和資訊管理業務、全球資料中心業務以及企業及其他業務。全球記錄和資訊管理業務部門提供用於儲存、管理、數位化和安全處置全球記錄和資訊的全面解決方案。全球資料中心業務部門提供資料中心設施，以保護關鍵任務資產並確保客戶 IT 基礎設施的持續運營，並提供安全可靠的託管和批發選項。企業及其他業務部門包括所有類型的實體媒體和數位內容儲存庫系統的儲存、保護和電子或實體交付，以容納、分發和存檔關鍵媒體資產，主要面向娛樂和媒體行業客戶。該公司由 Herman Knaust 於 1951 年創立，總部位於新罕布夏州朴茨茅斯。

info.description: Corvus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development of product candidates for the treatment of cancer and immune-mediated and inflammatory diseases. Its product candidates include soquelitinib, an ITK inhibitor, ciforadenant, an adenosine A2A receptor antagonist, and mupadolimab, a B cell-activating anti-CD73 antibody. The company was founded by Richard A. Miller, Peter A. Thompson, Joseph J. Buggy, and Erik Verner on January 27, 2014 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Corvus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 致力於開發治療癌症、免疫介導疾病和發炎性疾病的候選產品。其候選產品包括ITK抑制劑soquelitinib、腺苷A2A受體拮抗劑ciforadenan和B細胞活化抗CD73抗體mupadolimab。該公司由 Richard A. Miller、Peter A. Thompson、Joseph J. Buggy 和 Erik Verner 於 2014 年 1 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Semiconductor ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the semiconductor industry and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Semiconductor ESG 篩選指數的表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數投資方法，尋求與相關指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在半導體行業開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

Upstream Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of treatments for inflammatory diseases, with an initial focus on severe respiratory disorders. It develops verekitug, the only known antagonist currently in clinical development that targets the receptor for Thymic Stromal Lymphopoietin. The company was founded in April 2021 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Upstream Bio, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發發炎性疾病的治療方法，最初專注於嚴重的呼吸系統疾病。它開發了 verekitug，這是目前臨床開發中唯一已知的針對胸腺基質淋巴細胞生成素受體的拮抗劑。該公司成立於 2021 年 4 月，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Tema Electrification ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, which include borrowings for investment purposes, common and preferred stocks of publicly listed companies that are directly or indirectly economically tied to global electrification. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tema Electrification ETF 尋求提供長期資本成長。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過投資至少80%的淨資產來實現其投資目標，其中包括用於投資目的的借款、與全球電氣化經濟直接或間接相關的上市公司的普通股和優先股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lam Research Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, marketing, refurbishment, and provision of semiconductor processing equipment used in the fabrication of integrated circuits. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, China, Europe, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, and Taiwan. The company was founded by David K. Lam in 1980 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Lam Research Corp. 從事設計、製造、行銷、翻新和提供用於積體電路製造的半導體加工設備。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、中國、歐洲、日本、韓國、東南亞和台灣。該公司由 David K. Lam 於 1980 年創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Swarmer, Inc. is an AI-driven software company, which develops software platforms and AI systems for autonomous swarm control of drones and unmanned vehicles. The firm offers STYX AI Command and Control System, MINAS Autonomy and Collaboration AI, and TRIDENT Embedded Drone Operating System. The company was founded by Alex Fink and Serhii Kuprienko in May 2023 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Swarmer, Inc. 是一家由人工智慧驅動的軟體公司，開發用於無人機和無人駕駛車輛自主群體控制的軟體平台和人工智慧系統。該公司提供 STYX 人工智慧命令和控制系統、MINAS 自主和協作人工智慧以及 TRIDENT 嵌入式無人機作業系統。該公司由 Alex Fink 和 Serhii Kuprienko 於 2023 年 5 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: NestYield Visionary ETF seeks long-term growth; the fund's secondary investment objective is to seek current income. The fund's strategy involves two components: (1) purchasing a portfolio of equity securities either directly, or "synthetically" by using options to gain exposure to one or more equity securities; and (2) generating income through an options portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: NestYield Visionary ETF尋求長期成長；該基金的次要投資目標是尋求當前收入。本基金的策略涉及兩個組成部分：(1) 直接購買股權證券投資組合，或透過使用選擇權「綜合」購買一種或多種股權證券； (2) 透過選擇權投資組合產生收入。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sandisk Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, and provision of storage devices and solutions based on NAND flash technology. Its products include solid state drives, memory cards, and USB flash drives. The company was founded on February 5, 2024 and is headquartered in Milpitas, CA.
info.description_zh: Sandisk Corp. 從事開發、製造和提供基於 NAND 快閃記憶體技術的儲存設備和解決方案。其產品包括固態硬碟、記憶卡和USB隨身碟。該公司成立於 2024 年 2 月 5 日，總部位於加州米爾皮塔斯。

info.description: Direxion Daily MRVL Bull 2X ETF is an aggressively managed single-stock leveraged exchange-traded fund that seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily price performance of the common shares of Marvell Technology, Inc. The fund is designed as a tactical tool for sophisticated investors to amplify short-term bullish views on a leading designer of infrastructure semiconductor solutions through the use of financial derivative instruments, requiring active daily monitoring due to the effects of compounding and leverage.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily MRVL Bull 2X ETF 是一款積極管理的單股槓桿交易所交易基金，尋求 Marvell Technology, Inc. 普通股每日價格表現 200% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金被設計為成熟投資者的戰術工具，透過使用金融衍生工具來放大對基礎設施半導體解決方案領先設計商的短期看漲觀點，由於複利和槓桿的影響，需要進行主動日常監控。

info.description: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the technology sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家科技業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Everspin Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of magnetoresistive random access memory (MRAM) solutions. Its products include Toggle MRAM, Spin-transfer Torque MRAM, TMR Sensors, and Embedded MRAM. The company was founded by Saied Tehrani on May 16, 2008 and is headquartered in Chandler, AZ.
info.description_zh: Everspin Technologies, Inc. 致力於提供磁阻隨機存取記憶體 (MRAM) 解決方案。其產品包括切換 MRAM、自旋轉移扭矩 MRAM、TMR 感測器和嵌入式 MRAM。該公司由 Saied Tehrani 於 2008 年 5 月 16 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州錢德勒。

info.description: Seagate Technology Holdings Plc operates as holding company that is engaged in the development, production, and distribution of data storage products and electronic data storage solutions. Its products include hard disk drives, solid state hybrid drives, solid state drives, peripheral component interconnect express cards, serial advanced technology attachment controllers, storage subsystems and computing solutions. The firm offers its products under the Backup Plus and Expansion product lines, and Maxtor and LaCie brands. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Seagate Technology Holdings Plc 作為控股公司運營，從事資料儲存產品和電子資料儲存解決方案的開發、生產和分銷。其產品包括硬碟、固態混合​​驅動器、固態驅動器、週邊組件互連快速卡、串列先進技術附件控制器、儲存子系統和運算解決方案。該公司提供 Backup Plus 和 Expansion 產品線以及 Maxtor 和 LaCie 品牌的產品。該公司成立於1978年，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: CECO Environmental Corp. engages in the provision of engineering technology and solutions. It offers services in the field of environment, energy, fluid handling, and filtration. The firm operates through the following segments: Engineered Systems and Industrial Process Solutions segment. The Engineered Systems segment serves the power generation, hydrocarbon processing, water/wastewater treatment, oily water separation and treatment, marine and naval vessels, and midstream oil and gas sectors. The Industrial Process Solutions segment serves the broad industrial sector with solutions for air pollution and contamination control, fluid handling, and process filtration in applications such as aluminum beverage can production, automobile production, food and beverage processing, semiconductor fabrication, electronics production, steel and aluminum mill processing, wood manufacturing, desalination, and aquaculture markets. The company was founded by Phillip DeZwirek in 1966 and is headquartered in Addison, TX.
info.description_zh: 希柯環保股份有限公司從事提供工程技術和解決方案。它提供環境、能源、流體處理和過濾領域的服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：工程系統和工業過程解決方案部門。工程系統部門服務於發電、碳氫化合物加工、水/廢水處理、含油水分離和處理、船舶和中游石油和天然氣領域。工業製程解決方案部門為廣泛的工業領域提供空氣污染和污染控制、流體處理和製程過濾解決方案，應用於鋁製飲料罐生產、汽車生產、食品和飲料加工、半導體製造、電子產品生產、鋼鐵和鋁廠加工、木材製造、海水淡化和水產養殖市場。該公司由 Phillip DeZwirek 於 1966 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州艾迪生。

info.description: Viavi Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of network test, monitoring, and assurance solutions for communications service providers, enterprises, network equipment manufacturers, government and avionics. It operates through the following segments: Network and Service Enablement, and Optical Security and Performance. The Network and Service Enablement segment provides an integrated portfolio of testing, monitoring, assurance and security solutions to help build, maintain and optimize telecom and datacom networks. The Optical Security and Performance segment leverages its core optical coating technologies and volume manufacturing capability to design, manufacture and sell technologies for the anti-counterfeiting, 3D sensing, government and aerospace, automotive and industrial markets. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Chandler, AZ.
info.description_zh: Viavi Solutions, Inc. 致力於為通訊服務供應商、企業、網路設備製造商、政府和航空電子設備提供網路測試、監控和保障解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：網路和服務支援以及光安全和效能。網路和服務支援部門提供測試、監控、保證和安全解決方案的整合產品組合，以協助建置、維護和最佳化電信和資料通訊網路。光學安全和性能部門利用其核心光學鍍膜技術和批量製造能力，為防偽、3D 感測、政府和航空航天、汽車和工業市場設計、製造和銷售技術。該公司成立於 1979 年，總部位於亞利桑那州錢德勒。

info.description: Mercury Systems, Inc. is an aerospace and defense electronics company, providing breakthrough capabilities in signal and data processing. The company was founded on July 14, 1981 and is headquartered in Andover, MA.
info.description_zh: Mercury Systems, Inc. 是一家航空航太和國防電子公司，在訊號和資料處理方面提供突破性的能力。該公司成立於 1981 年 7 月 14 日，總部位於馬薩諸塞州安多佛。

info.description: Semtech Corp. engages in the manufacture and supply of analog and mixed signal semiconductor products for high-end consumer, enterprise computing, communications, and industrial equipment. It operates through the following segments: Signal Integrity, Analog Mixed Signal and Wireless, and Internet of Things (IoT) Systems and Connectivity. The Signal Integrity segment includes designing, development, manufacturing, and marketing of a portfolio of optical and copper data communications and video transport products used in a wide variety of infrastructure and industrial applications. The Analog Mixed Signal and Wireless segment focus on designing, development, manufacturing, and marketing of transient voltage suppressors and specialized sensing products. The IoT Systems and Connectivity segment includes designing, development, operation, and marketing of a portfolio of IoT solutions that enable businesses to connect and manage devices, collect and analyze data, and improve decision-making. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Camarillo, CA.
info.description_zh: Semtech Corp. 致力於為高端消費、企業運算、通訊和工業設備製造和供應類比和混合訊號半導體產品。它透過以下部門運作：訊號完整性、類比混合訊號和無線、以及物聯網 (IoT) 系統和連接。訊號完整性部門包括設計、開發、製造和行銷用於各種基礎設施和工業應用的光和銅數據通訊以及視訊傳輸產品組合。類比混合訊號和無線部門專注於瞬態電壓抑制器和專用感測產品的設計、開發、製造和行銷。物聯網系統和連接部門包括物聯網解決方案組合的設計、開發、營運和行銷，使企業能夠連接和管理設備、收集和分析數據以及改善決策。該公司成立於 1960 年，總部位於加州卡馬裡奧。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on February 5, 2024, and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. II 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年2月5日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: PS International Group Ltd. engages in providing logistics and supply chain solutions. The company was founded on September 12, 2023 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: PS International Group Ltd. 致力於提供物流和供應鏈解決方案。該公司成立於2023年9月12日，總部位於香港。

info.description: YD Bio Ltd. is a biotechnology company building an integrated healthcare platform across regulated diagnostics, clinical services, and commercial healthcare markets. It operates DNA methylation-based oncology testing programs under an LDT-first strategy and provides compliant life science distribution and clinical trial supply chain services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners. The company's offerings include cancer detection products, regenerative ophthalmology solutions, and exosome-based technologies. YD Bio was founded on February 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: YD Bio Ltd. 是一家生物技術公司，在受監管的診斷、臨床服務和商業醫療保健市場上建立綜合醫療保健平台。該公司在 LDT 優先策略下經營基於 DNA 甲基化的腫瘤檢測項目，並為製藥和生物技術合作夥伴提供合規的生命科學分銷和臨床試驗供應鏈服務。該公司的產品包括癌症檢測產品、再生眼科解決方案和基於外泌體的技術。勇鼎生物成立於2024年2月6日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: BTC Digital Ltd. is a blockchain technology company, with a long-term strategy to create value across the metaverse, blockchain and cryptocurrency mining industry. The company was founded by Yu Peng Guo in April 2006 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: BTC Digital Ltd.是一家區塊鏈技術公司，其長期戰略是在元宇宙、區塊鏈和加密貨幣挖礦行業創造價值。該公司由郭於鵬於2006年4月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: AI Financial Corp. is a fintech company which engages in blockchain-powered technologies for digital asset trading, payments processing and related payment card services. It provides regulated institutional-grade Crypto-as-a-Service infrastructure for the digital asset economy. The company was founded by Edward R. Cameron in 1976 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: AI Financial Corp.是一家金融科技公司，從事數位資產交易、支付處理和相關支付卡服務的區塊鏈技術。它為數位資產經濟提供受監管的機構級加密即服務基礎設施。該公司由 Edward R. Cameron 於 1976 年創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. provides public market investors with broad exposure to the programmable intellectual property economy in a regulated equity format. Its treasury reserve of digital tokens enables direct participation in the Story ecosystem, which supports on-chain registration, licensing, and monetization of intellectual property. The company was founded by Justin B. Stiefel and Jennifer D. H. Stiefel on July 19, 2011 and is headquartered in Gig Harbor, WA.
info.description_zh: IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. 以受監管的股權形式為公開市場投資者提供廣泛的可編程智慧財產權經濟投資機會。其數位代幣的財務儲備可以直接參與 Story 生態系統，支援智慧財產權的鏈上註冊、授權和貨幣化。該公司由 Justin B. Stiefel 和 Jennifer D. H. Stiefel 於 2011 年 7 月 19 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州吉格港。

info.description: Beam Global provides sustainable products and technologies for electric vehicle (EV) charging, energy storage, energy security and outdoor media. It develops, patents, designs, engineers and manufactures unique and advanced clean mobility solutions that protect the environment, save customers time and money, empower communities and keep people moving. The firm's core platforms include Beam EV ARC and Solar Tree sustainable EV charging systems, Beam AllCell high-performance energy storage solutions, energy resiliency and disaster preparedness products and a deep patent library. The company was founded by Robert Lane Noble on June 12, 2006 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Beam Global 為電動車 (EV) 充電、能源儲存、能源安全和戶外媒體提供永續產品和技術。它開發、專利、設計、工程和製造獨特且先進的清潔行動解決方案，以保護環境、節省客戶時間和金錢、增強社區能力並讓人們繼續旅行。該公司的核心平台包括 Beam EV ARC 和 Solar Tree 永續電動車充電系統、Beam AllCell 高性能儲能解決方案、能源彈性和備災產品以及深厚的專利庫。該公司由 Robert Lane Noble 於 2006 年 6 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Canaan, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in developing and selling Bitcoin mining machines and related services. It focuses on the development of green mining. The company was founded by Jia Xuan Li, Xiang Fu Liu and Nan Geng Zhang on January 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Canaan, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事開發和銷售比特幣礦機及相關服務。重點發展綠色礦業。該公司由李嘉軒、劉向福和張南庚於2013年1月19日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Profusa, Inc. engages in biofeedback for chronic disease management and healthy living services. The company is founded by Natalie Wisniewski and Bill McMillan and is headquartered in Berkeley, CA.
info.description_zh: Profusa, Inc. 致力於慢性病管理和健康生活服務的生物回饋。該公司由 Natalie Wisniewski 和 Bill McMillan 創立，總部位於加州伯克利。

info.description: 21Shares 2x Long Sui ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of SUI. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's assets in, or provide exposure equal to, financial instruments that the Adviser and Sub-Adviser believe, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective of seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of SUI. The fund does not invest directly in SUI. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 21Shares 2x Long Sui ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 SUI 每日價格表現的兩倍 (2x)。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的基金資產投資於顧問和副顧問認為組合起來應產生與基金的投資目標一致的每日回報（不包括費用和開支）的金融工具，或提供相當於 SUI 每日價格表現兩倍 (2x) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金不直接投資於 SUI。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long COIN Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of COIN. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics, that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to COIN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股份 2 倍多頭 COIN 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 COIN 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 COIN 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Personalis, Inc. engages in the provision of advanced genomic tests for cancer. The firm is also involved in providing sequencing and data analysis services to support population sequencing initiatives. The company was founded by Euan A. Ashley, Michael Snyder, Atul J. Butte, John S. West, and Russ B. Altman in February 2011 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Personalis, Inc. 致力於提供先進的癌症基因組測試。該公司還提供定序和數據分析服務，以支援群體定序計劃。該公司由 Euan A. Ashley、Michael Snyder、Atul J. Butte、John S. West 和 Russ B. Altman 於 2011 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.5x Long COIN Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.5 times (150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Coinbase Global, Inc. Class A. The fund is a passively managed etf that attempts to replicate 1.5 times (150%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The adviser will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the adviser and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 1.5 倍多頭 COIN 每日 ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果，為 Coinbase Global, Inc. A 類普通股每日百分比變化的 1.5 倍 (150%)。該基金是被動管理的 ETF，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期協議來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 1.5 倍 (150%)。顧問將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，顧問和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報。它是非多元化的。

info.description: DeFi Development Corp. provides business and commercial property financing services. It provides technology that connects commercial mortgage borrowers looking for debt to refinance, build, or buy commercial property including apartment buildings to commercial property lenders (including banks, credit unions, REITs, debt funds, and more) looking to deploy capital into commercial mortgages. The company was founded by Blake E. Janover on November 28, 2018 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: DeFi Development Corp. 提供商業和商業房地產融資服務。它提供的技術將尋求債務再融資、建造或購買商業房地產（包括公寓大樓）的商業抵押貸款借款人與尋求將資本配置到商業抵押貸款的商業房地產貸款人（包括銀行、信用合作社、房地產投資信託基金、債務基金等）聯繫起來。該公司由 Blake E. Janover 於 2018 年 11 月 28 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Invivyd, Inc. engages in the discovery, development and commercialization of antibody-based solutions for infectious diseases with pandemic potential. The firm develops antibodies that can neutralize SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV-1, and additional emergent coronaviruses. It offers ADG20, a monoclonal antibody, targeting the spike protein of SARS-CoV-2 and related coronaviruses. The company was founded by Tillman U. Gerngross, Ren Russo and Laura Walker on June 3, 2020 and is headquartered in New Haven, CT.
info.description_zh: Invivyd, Inc. 致力於針對具有大流行潛力的傳染病的基於抗體的解決方案的發現、開發和商業化。該公司開發的抗體可以中和 SARS-CoV-2、SARS-CoV-1 和其他新出現的冠狀病毒。它提供 ADG20，一種單株抗體，針對 SARS-CoV-2 和相關冠狀病毒的刺突蛋白。該公司由 Tillman U. Gerngross、Ren Russo 和 Laura Walker 於 2020 年 6 月 3 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州紐黑文。

info.description: A SPAC III Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. The company was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on September 3, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: SPAC III Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。公司成立的目的是進行合併、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年9月3日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Almonty Industries, Inc. engages in the mining, processing, and shipment of tungsten concentrates. Its projects include Almonty Korea Tungsten, Panasquiera mine, Gentung, Almonty Korea Moly, Los Santos mine, and Valtreixal. The company was founded on September 28, 2009 and is headquartered in Dillon, MT.
info.description_zh: Almonty Industries, Inc. 從事鎢精礦的開採、加工和運輸。其項目包括阿爾蒙蒂韓國鎢礦、帕納斯奎拉礦、Gentung、阿爾蒙蒂韓國鉬業、洛斯桑托斯礦和Valtreixal。該公司成立於2009年9月28日，總部位於蒙大拿州狄龍。

info.description: Hyperliquid Strategies, Inc. is a holding and operating company, which engages in the business of crypto asset management. The firm operates as a digital asset treasury company which focuses on the Hyperliquid ecosystem. The company was founded on July 2, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Hyperliquid Strategies, Inc.是一家控股和營運公司，從事加密資產管理業務。該公司是一家專注於 Hyperliquid 生態系統的數位資產財務公司。該公司成立於2025年7月2日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: eXoZymes, Inc. is a development stage synthetic biochemical company. Its synthetic biology platform would enable the scalable exploration of many molecules and properties found in nature. The company was founded by Tyler Korman and Paul Opgenorth in April 2019 and is headquartered in Monrovia, NV.
info.description_zh: eXoZymes, Inc. 是一家處於發展階段的合成生化公司。其合成生物學平台將使對自然界中發現的許多分子和特性的可擴展探索成為可能。該公司由 Tyler Korman 和 Paul Opgenorth 於 2019 年 4 月創立，總部位於內華達州蒙羅維亞。

info.description: 21Shares 2x Long Dogecoin ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of DOGE. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's assets in, or provide exposure equal to, financial instruments that the Adviser and Sub-Adviser believe, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective of seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of DOGE. The fund does not invest directly in DOGE. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 21Shares 2x 多吉幣 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 DOGE 每日價格表現的兩倍 (2x)。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的基金資產投資於顧問和副顧問認為組合起來應產生與基金的投資目標一致的每日回報（不包括費用和開支）的金融工具，或提供相當於 DOGE 每日價格表現兩倍 (2x) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金不直接投資於 DOGE。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Precipio, Inc.is a cancer diagnostics and reagent technology company, which provides diagnostic products and services to the oncology market. It operates through the following business divisions: Pathology Services and Products. The Pathology Services division provides specialized cancer diagnostic testing services to physicians, hospitals, and laboratories. The Products divisions develops and commercializes proprietary assays designed for use by clinical laboratories. The company was founded on March 6, 1997 and is headquartered in New Haven, CT.
info.description_zh: Precipio, Inc.是一家癌症診斷和試劑技術公司，為腫瘤市場提供診斷產品和服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：病理服務和產品。病理學服務部門為醫生、醫院和實驗室提供專業的癌症診斷測試​​服務。產品部門開發並商業化專為臨床實驗室使用而設計的專有檢測方法。該公司成立於1997年3月6日，總部位於康乃狄克州紐黑文。

info.description: Coinbase Global, Inc. engages in the provision of a trusted platform that serves as a compliant on-ramp to the onchain economy and enables users to engage in a wide variety of activities with their crypto assets in both proprietary and third-party product experiences enabled by access to decentralized applications. It offers consumers primary financial account for the cryptoeconomy, institutions a full-service prime brokerage platform with access to deep pools of liquidity across the crypto marketplace, and developers a suite of products granting access to build onchain. The company was founded by Brian Armstrong and Fred Ernest Ehrsam in May 2012 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Coinbase Global, Inc. 致力於提供一個值得信賴的平台，作為鏈上經濟的合規入口，使用戶能夠透過訪問去中心化應用程序，在專有和第三方產品體驗中使用其加密資產參與各種活動。它為消費者提供加密經濟的主要金融帳戶，為機構提供全方位服務的主要經紀平台，可以存取整個加密市場的深層流動性池，並為開發人員提供一套允許在鏈上構建的產品。該公司由 Brian Armstrong 和 Fred Ernest Ehrsam 於 2012 年 5 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Aemetis, Inc. is a renewable fuels and biochemical company, which engages in the acquisition, development, and commercialization of technologies that replace traditional petroleum-based products. It operates through the North America and India geographical segments. The North America segment manages Keyes Plant in California, the cellulosic ethanol facility in Riverbank, the cluster of biogas digesters on dairies near Keyes, California, the Goodland Plant, Kansas and the research and development facility in Minnesota. The India segment refers to the Kakinada plant, administrative offices in Hyderabad, and holding companies in Nevada and Mauritius. Its products include glycerin, ethanol, food and feed, biodiesel, and edible oils. The company was founded by Eric Armstrong McAfee in 2006 and is headquartered in Cupertino, CA.
info.description_zh: Aemetis, Inc. 是一家再生燃料和生化公司，致力於替代傳統石油產品的技術的收購、開發和商業化。它透過北美和印度地理部門開展業務。北美部門管理加州凱斯工廠、Riverbank 的纖維素乙醇工廠、加州凱斯附近乳品廠的沼氣池集群、堪薩斯州古德蘭工廠以及明尼蘇達州的研發設施。印度部門是指卡基納達工廠、海得拉巴的行政辦公室以及內華達州和毛里求斯的控股公司。其產品包括甘油、乙醇、食品和飼料、生質柴油和食用油。該公司由 Eric Armstrong McAfee 於 2006 年創立，總部位於加州庫比蒂諾。

info.description: BTCS, Inc. is a blockchain technology company. Its operations include Validator Node Operations, Block Building, and Decentralized Finance Operations. The company was founded by Timothy Sidie and Michal Handerhan on April 15, 2008 and is headquartered in Wayne, PA.
info.description_zh: BTCS, Inc.是一家區塊鏈技術公司。其營運包括驗證節點運營、區塊構建和去中心化金融運營。該公司由 Timothy Sidie 和 Michal Handerhan 於 2008 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州韋恩。

info.description: Grayscale Hyperliquid Staking ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded product that is solely and passively invested in HYPE, the native token of the Hyperliquid blockchain protocol, aiming to reflect the value of the token held by the fund less expenses and liabilities. The strategy provides direct single-asset crypto exposure in an exchange-traded product wrapper, including capturing potential native protocol staking rewards generated by the underlying digital asset.
info.description_zh: Grayscale Hyperliquid Stake ETF 是一種被動管理的交易所交易產品，單獨被動投資於 Hyperliquid 區塊鏈協議的原生代幣 HYPE，旨在反映基金持有的代幣減去費用和負債後的價值。該策略在交易所交易產品包裝器中提供直接的單一資產加密貨幣敞口，包括捕獲基礎數位資產產生的潛在本機協議質押獎勵。

info.description: Strategy, Inc. engages in the development of fixed-income instruments that provide investors varying degrees of economic exposure to bitcoin. It executes bitcoin acquisition, capital management, and capital markets strategies. The company was founded by Michael J. Saylor and Sanjeev K. Bansal on November 17, 1989, and is headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA.
info.description_zh: Strategy, Inc. 致力於開發固定收益工具，為投資者提供不同程度的比特幣經濟風險。它執行比特幣收購、資本管理和資本市場策略。該公司由 Michael J. Saylor 和 Sanjeev K. Bansal 於 1989 年 11 月 17 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州泰森斯角。

info.description: Wetour Robotics Ltd. operates as a holding company. It engages in the provision of mobility solutions with artificial intelligence augmented online support and itinerary management support. The firm offers shuttle, customized chartered bus, packaged tour, and other services to customers. The company was founded on February 10, 2022 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Wetour Robotics Ltd. 以控股公司方式營運。它致力於提供具有人工智慧增強線上支援和行程管理支援的行動解決方案。該公司為客戶提供接駁車、客製化包車、跟團遊等服務。公司成立於2022年2月10日，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Borealis Foods, Inc. is an integrated food manufacturing company, which engages in the production of ready-to-eat meals and dry soup products. The company offers ramen noodle brands including Chef Woo, Ramen Express, and Woodles. It partners with national and international food producers, retailers, and distributors. Borealis Foods was founded by Reza Soltanzadeh and Barthelemy Helg in July 2019 and is headquartered in Oakville, Canada.
info.description_zh: Borealis Foods, Inc.是一家綜合食品製造公司，從事即食食品和乾湯產品的生產。該公司提供拉麵品牌，包括 Chef Woo、Ramen Express 和 Woodles。它與國內外食品生產商、零售商和分銷商合作。 Borealis Foods 由 Reza Soltanzadeh 和 Barthelemy Helg 於 2019 年 7 月創立，總部位於加拿大奧克維爾。

info.description: Grayscale Avalanche Staking ETF is a physically-backed exchange-traded product designed to provide passive exposure to the market price of AVAX, the native token of the Avalanche network, by holding the digital asset directly. The strategy distinguishes itself by incorporating a staking component, whereby the fund participates in the network's Proof of Stake consensus mechanism to earn rewards, which are then reflected in the value of the shares alongside the underlying asset's price performance.
info.description_zh: Grayscale Avalanche Stake ETF 是一種實體支援的交易所交易產品，旨在透過直接持有數位資產，提供對 Avalanche 網路原生代幣 AVAX 市場價格的被動敞口。該策略的獨特之處在於納入了質押成分，即基金參與網絡的權益證明共識機制以賺取獎勵，然後這些獎勵會反映在股票價值以及標的資產的價格表現中。

info.description: Arbutus Biopharma Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing novel therapeutics that target specific viral diseases. It focuses on the development of imdusiran (AB-729), proprietary, conjugated GalNAc, subcutaneously-delivered RNAi therapeutic, and AB-101, proprietary oral PD-L1 inhibitor, for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (cHBV). The company was founded on October 6, 2005 and is headquartered in Warminster, PA.
info.description_zh: Arbutus Biopharma Corp.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對特定病毒性疾病的新型療法。它專注於開發imdusiran (AB-729)，一種專有的綴合GalNAc，皮下遞送的RNAi治療劑，以及AB-101，一種專有的口服PD-L1抑制劑，用於治療慢性乙型肝炎(cHBV)。該公司成立於2005年10月6日，總部位於賓州沃明斯特。

info.description: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. is a long-term strategic treasury of Hyperliquid's native token HYPE. The firm provides investors with streamlined access to the Hyperliquid ecosystem and is also developing its proprietary Optejet user-filled device, designed for use with a variety of topical ophthalmic liquids, including artificial tears and lens rewetting products. It operates through the following segments: Ophthalmic Technology and Digital Assets. The Ophthalmic Technology segment focuses on developing eye-care devices and delivery systems for ophthalmic liquids. The Digital Assets segment focuses on managing a strategic treasury of blockchain-based assets and exposure to the Hyperliquid ecosystem. The company was founded by Sean Ianchulev on March 12, 2014 and is headquartered in Laguna Hills, CA.
info.description_zh: Hyperion DeFi, Inc. 是 Hyperliquid 原生代幣 HYPE 的長期策略金庫。該公司為投資者提供了進入 Hyperliquid 生態系統的簡化途徑，並且還在開發其專有的 Optejet 用戶填充設備，該設備設計用於各種局部眼科液體，包括人工淚液和鏡片再潤濕產品。它透過以下部門運作：眼科技術部門和數位資產部門。眼科技術部門專注於開發眼科護理設備和眼科液體輸送系統。數位資產部門專注於管理基於區塊鏈的資產的策略金庫以及對 Hyperliquid 生態系統的投資。該公司由 Sean Ianchulev 於 2014 年 3 月 12 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州拉古納山。

info.description: MeiraGTx Holdings Plc is a clinical-stage genetic medicines company with a broad pipeline of late-stage clinical programs, including Parkinson's disease, radiation-induced xerostomia and AIPL1-associated retinal dystrophy. It targets local delivery of small doses of genetic medicines to treat both inherited and more common conditions with severe unmet needs. The company was founded on March 20, 2015 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MeiraGTx Holdings Plc 是一家臨床階段的基因藥物公司，擁有廣泛的後期臨床項目，包括帕金森氏症、輻射引起的口乾症和 AIPL1 相關的視網膜營養不良。它的目標是在當地提供小劑量的基因藥物，以治療嚴重未滿足需求的遺傳性疾病和更常見的疾病。該公司成立於2015年3月20日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Celsius Holdings, Inc. engages in the development, marketing, sale, and distribution of functional drinks and liquid supplements. It also offers post-workout functional energy drinks and protein bars. The company was founded in April 2004 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Celeste Holdings, Inc. 從事功能性飲料和液體補充劑的開發、行銷、銷售和分銷。它還提供鍛煉後功能性能量飲料和蛋白質棒。該公司成立於 2004 年 4 月，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Sensus Healthcare, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the provision of treatment for both oncological and non-oncological skin conditions. The company was founded by Joseph C. Sardano, Richard Golin, Kalman Fishman, and Stephen Cohen on May 7, 2010 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Sensus Healthcare, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司，致力於為腫瘤和非腫瘤皮膚病提供治療。該公司由 Joseph C. Sardano、Richard Golin、Kalman Fishman 和 Stephen Cohen 於 2010 年 5 月 7 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of immuno-oncology therapeutics. The company was founded on September 8, 2011 and is headquartered in Marlborough, MA.
info.description_zh: Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp. 是一家生技公司，從事免疫腫瘤療法的開發。該公司成立於2011年9月8日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州馬爾伯勒。

info.description: Churchill Downs, Inc. is a provider of pari-mutuel horse racing, online account wagering on horse racing and casino gaming. It operates through the following segments: Live and Historical Racing, Wagering Services and Solutions, and Gaming. The Live and Historical Racing segment includes live and historical pari-mutuel racing related revenue and expenses at Churchill Downs Racetrack and historical racing properties in Kentucky, Virginia, and New Hampshire. The Wagering Services and Solutions focuses on the revenue and expenses from pari-mutuel wagers through TwinSpires, retail and online sports betting business, United Tote Company, and Exacta Systems, LLC. The Gaming segment is involved in the casino properties and associated racetracks which support the casino license. The company was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Louisville, KY.
info.description_zh: Churchill Downs, Inc. 是一家彩池賽馬、賽馬線上帳戶投注和賭場遊戲提供商。它透過以下部門運作：現場和歷史賽馬、投注服務和解決方案以及遊戲。現場和歷史賽馬部門包括丘吉爾唐斯賽馬場的現場和歷史彩池賽馬相關收入和支出，以及肯塔基州、維吉尼亞州和新罕布夏州的歷史賽馬場館。投注服務和解決方案專注於透過 TwinSpires、零售和線上體育博彩業務、United Tote Company 和 Exacta Systems, LLC 進行派利分成投注的收入和支出。遊戲部門涉及賭場資產和支援賭場許可證的相關賽馬場。該公司成立於 1875 年，總部位於肯塔基州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Novavax, Inc. Is a biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of recombinant vaccines. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.
info.description_zh: Novavax, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事重組疫苗的發現、開發和商業化。該公司成立於 1987 年，總部位於馬裡蘭州蓋瑟斯堡。

info.description: Precision BioSciences, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development of genome editing technologies. It operates through the Therapeutics and Food segments. The Therapeutics segment focuses on the development of products in the field of immuno-oncology and of novel products outside immuno-oncology to treat human diseases. The Food segment applies ARCUS, the company's proprietary genome editing platform, to develop food and nutrition products through collaboration agreements with consumer-facing companies. The company was founded by Derek N. Jantz, Jeff Smith, and Matthew R. Kane on January 26, 2006 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Precision BioSciences, Inc.是一家生技公司，從事基因組編輯技術的開發。它透過治療和食品部門運作。治療部門專注於免疫腫瘤學領域的產品開發以及免疫腫瘤學以外治療人類疾病的新產品的開發。食品部門採用該公司專有的基因組編輯平台 ARCUS，透過與面向消費者的公司達成合作協議來開發食品和營養產品。該公司由 Derek N. Jantz、Jeff Smith 和 Matthew R. Kane 於 2006 年 1 月 26 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Robinhood Markets, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. A downside protection may be implemented which could affect the net income level. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HOOD ETF 旨在通过出售杠杆交易所交易基金的期权来实现 2 倍 (200%) 出售 Robinhood Markets, Inc. 普通股期权所产生的收入，该基金旨在实现基础股票每日表现的 2 倍，并获得基础杠杆 ETF 表现的敞口，但须遵守潜在投资收益的上限。可能会实施下行保护，这可能会影响净利润水平。该基金将至少80%的净资产投资于以标的杠杆ETF作为参考资产的衍生品合约。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PrimeEnergy Resources Corp. is an independent oil and natural gas company, which engages in the business of acquiring, developing, and producing oil and natural gas. The firm is also involved in selling oil and natural gas and liquids production to a number of direct purchasers under direct contracts or through other operators under joint operating agreements. The company was founded on March 22, 1973 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: PrimeEnergy Resources Corp.是一家獨立的石油和天然氣公司，從事石油和天然氣的收購、開發和生產業務。該公司還根據直接合約或根據聯合經營協議透過其他業者向許多直接購買者銷售石油、天然氣和液體產品。該公司成立於1973年3月22日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: T Stamp, Inc. engages in development of proprietary artificial intelligence-powered solutions. It also focuses on researching and leveraging machine learning artificial intelligence, including computer vision, cryptography, and data mining, to process and protect data for identification against fraud. The company was founded by Gareth Genner, Andrew Gowasack, Catherine Lambert and Mike Lindenau on November 9, 2015 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: T Stamp, Inc. 致力於開發專有的人工智慧驅動解決方案。它還專注於研究和利用機器學習人工智慧，包括電腦視覺、密碼學和資料探勘，來處理和保護資料以防止詐欺。該公司由 Gareth Genner、Andrew Gowasack、Catherine Lambert 和 Mike Lindenau 於 2015 年 11 月 9 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Duos Technologies Group, Inc. designs, develops, deploys, and operates intelligent technology solutions supporting rail, logistics, intermodal and government customers that streamlines operations, improves safety and reduces costs. It offers imaging, safety and security, software, and services. The firm also provides cutting edge solutions that automate the mechanical and security inspection of fast moving trains, trucks and automobiles through a broad range of proprietary hardware, software, information technology and artificial intelligence. The company was founded on May 31, 1994 and is headquartered in Jacksonville, FL.
info.description_zh: Duos Technologies Group, Inc. 設計、開發、部署和營運智慧技術解決方案，為鐵路、物流、聯運和政府客戶提供支持，從而簡化營運、提高安全性並降低成本。它提供影像、安全保障、軟體和服務。該公司還提供尖端的解決方案，透過廣泛的專有硬體、軟體、資訊技術和人工智慧，對快速移動的火車、卡車和汽車進行機械和安全檢查的自動化。該公司成立於1994年5月31日，總部位於佛羅裡達州傑克遜維爾。

info.description: Myseum.AI, Inc. operates as a communication software company. Its product, DatChat Messenger & Private Social Network, is a mobile application that gives users the ability to communicate with privacy and protection. The company's DatChat application allows users to exercise control over their messages, even after they are sent. Through the application, users can delete messages that they have sent on their own device and the recipient's device as well. Its DatChat application also enables users to hide secret and encrypted messages behind a cover, which messages can only be unlocked by the recipient and which are automatically destroyed after a fixed number of views or fixed amount of time and also includes a screen shot protection system, which makes it virtually impossible for the recipient to screenshot a message or picture before it gets destroyed. Its application also integrates with iMessage, making private messages potentially available to hundreds of millions of users. The company was founded by Darin M. Myman and Peter Shelus on December 4, 2014 and is headquartered in New Brunswick, NJ.
info.description_zh: Myseum.AI, Inc. 是一家通訊軟體公司。其產品 DatChat Messenger & Private Social Network 是一款行動應用程序，使用戶能夠在隱私和保護的情況下進行通訊。該公司的 DatChat 應用程式允許用戶對其訊息進行控制，甚至在訊息發送後也是如此。透過該應用程序，用戶可以刪除他們在自己的裝置和收件人的裝置上發送的訊息。其 DatChat 應用程式還使用戶能夠將秘密和加密的訊息隱藏在封面後面，這些訊息只能由收件人解鎖，並且在固定的查看次數或固定的時間後自動銷毀，並且還包括螢幕截圖保護系統，這使得收件人幾乎不可能在訊息或圖片被銷毀之前對其進行螢幕截圖。其應用程式還與 iMessage 集成，使數億用戶可以使用私人訊息。該公司由 Darin M. Myman 和 Peter Shelus 於 2014 年 12 月 4 日創立，總部位於新澤西州新不倫瑞克。

info.description: Illumination Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on November 18, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Illumination Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年11月18日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Focus Five Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust sector-based ETFs that the index provider believes offer the greatest potential to outperform the other ETFs in the selection universe and that satisfy certain trading volume and liquidity requirements.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Focus Five 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。該指數旨在提供對 First Trust 五個基於行業的 ETF 的有針對性的投資，指數提供者認為這些 ETF 具有超越精選範圍內其他 ETF 的最大潛力，並且滿足一定的交易量和流動性要求。

info.description: Robinhood Markets, Inc is a financial services platform, which engages in the provision of retail brokerage and offers trading in U.S. listed stocks and Exchange Traded Funds, related options, and cryptocurrency trading, as well as cash management, which includes debit cards services. The company was founded by Vladimir Tenev and Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt in 2013 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Robinhood Markets, Inc 是一家金融服務平台，從事提供零售經紀業務，並提供美國上市股票和交易所交易基金、相關選擇權、加密貨幣交易以及現金管理（包括金融卡服務）的交易。該公司由 Vladimir Tenev 和 Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 24, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月24日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Atlas Lithium Corp. operates as a U.S. mineral exploration and mining company with projects and properties in essentially all battery metals, including lithium, rare earths, graphite, nickel, cobalt, and titanium. The firm focuses on developing its hard-rock lithium project located in a premier pegmatitic district in Brazil Minas Gerais and Northeastern Brazil. Additionally, through subsidiaries, it participates in iron, gold, and quartzite projects and owns multiple mining concessions for gold, diamond, and industrial sand. The company was founded on December 15, 2011 and is headquartered in Minas Gerais,BR.
info.description_zh: Atlas Lithium Corp.是一家美國礦產勘探和採礦公司，擁有幾乎所有電池金屬的專案和財產，包括鋰、稀土、石墨、鎳、鈷和鈦。該公司專注於開發位於巴西米納斯吉拉斯州和巴西東北部首要偉晶岩地區的硬岩鋰計畫。此外，它還透過子公司參與鐵、金和石英岩項目，並擁有多個黃金、鑽石和工業砂的採礦特許權。該公司成立於2011年12月15日，總部位於巴西米納斯吉拉斯州。

info.description: BTC Development Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 3, 2023 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: BTC Development Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年4月3日，總部位於賓州費城。

info.description: Big Digital Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of digital asset infrastructure services. The company was founded on February 10, 2012 and is headquartered in Midland, PA.
info.description_zh: Big Digital Energy, Inc.從事提供數位資產基礎設施服務。該公司成立於2012年2月10日，總部位於賓州米德蘭市。

info.description: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on November 1, 2024 and is headquartered Mountainside, NJ.
info.description_zh: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立是為了實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 11 月 1 日，總部位於新澤西州芒廷賽德。

info.description: CEA Industries, Inc. engages in in the development, design, and distribution of cultivation technologies for controlled environment agriculture, primarily for cannabis crops. It operates through the following segments: BNB Treasury Management and Retail and Industry. The BNB Treasury Management segment operates directly related to the company's DAT strategy, including the acquisition, disposition, and management of the company's BNB holdings or other digital assets such as Airdrops. The Retail and Industry segment deals with the Fat Panda's retail and distribution operations along with revenue and operating costs related to designing, engineering, and selling industrial climate control systems for controlled environment agriculture. The company was founded by Brandy Marie Keen and Stephen Keen on October 15, 2009 and is headquartered in Louisville, CO.
info.description_zh: CEA Industries, Inc. 從事受控環境農業（主要針對大麻作物）種植技術的開發、設計和分銷。它透過以下部門運作：BNB 資金管理部門以及零售和工業部門。 BNB資金管理部門的營運與公司的DAT策略直接相關，包括收購、處置和管理公司持有的BNB或空投等其他數位資產。零售和工業部門負責 Fat Panda 的零售和分銷業務，以及與設計、工程和銷售用於受控環境農業的工業氣候控制系統相關的收入和營運成本。該公司由 Brandy Marie Keen 和 Stephen Keen 於 2009 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州路易斯維爾。

info.description: Cenntro, Inc. is a commercial electric vehicle technology company, which engages in the designing, manufacturing, distribution, and servicing of commercial vehicles powered by electricity and hydrogen energy sources. It provides support to city services, last-mile delivery, and other commercial applications. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Iselin, NJ.
info.description_zh: Centntro, Inc.是一家商用電動車技術公司，從事電力和氫能商用車輛的設計、製造、分銷和服務。它為城市服務、最後一哩交付和其他商業應用提供支援。該公司成立於 2013 年，總部位於新澤西州艾斯林。

info.description: Cingulate, Inc. operates as a clinical stage bio pharmaceutical company using a Precision Timed Release drug delivery platform technology to build a pipeline of next-generation pharmaceutical products. The firm initially focused on the treatment of Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD). It identifies and evaluates additional therapeutic areas, PTR technology employed to develop future product candidates. Cingulate was founded by Shane J. Schaffer, Craig Steven Gilgallon, Raul R. Silva, Matthew N. Brams in May 2012 and is headquartered in Kansas City, KS.

info.description: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals Ltd. operates as a biopharmaceutical company. The firm engages in the development of SCENESSE, its proprietary photoprotective drug. It also offers drugs for the treatment of various skin disorders. The company was founded by Robert Thomas Dorr on December 14, 1999 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals Ltd. 是一家生物製藥公司。該公司致力於開發其專有的光保護藥物 SCENESSE。它還提供治療各種皮膚病的藥物。該公司由Robert Thomas Dorr於1999年12月14日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: Datacentrex, Inc. is a digital infrastructure and capital deployment company. It engages in the owning and operating of Scrypt to compute assets and evaluate strategic transactions across asset-backed operating businesses. The company was founded by Robert Steele and Daniel Lupinelli on October 27, 2019 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Datacentrex, Inc. 是一家數位基礎架構和資本部署公司。它從事 Scrypt 的擁有和運營，以計算資產並評估資產支援營運業務的策略交易。該公司由 Robert Steele 和 Daniel Lupinelli 於 2019 年 10 月 27 日創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. is a U.S. based critical materials and advanced manufacturing company for rare earth permanent magnets, battery materials, and related critical minerals and technologies. The firm's commercial-scale operations, advanced processing technologies, and strategic partnerships operate what it believes is the only vertically integrated critical materials supply chain spanning end-of-life electronics and batteries, high-grade concentrates, and the manufacture of finished rare earth magnets and battery materials. The company is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. 是一家美國關鍵材料和先進製造公司，生產稀土永久磁鐵、電池材料以及相關關​​鍵礦物和技術。該公司的商業規模運營、先進的加工技術和戰略合作夥伴關係運營著其認為唯一垂直整合的關鍵材料供應鏈，涵蓋報廢電子產品和電池、高品位精礦以及成品稀土磁體和電池材料的製造。該公司總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Ernexa Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the provision of cell engineering therapies. It is involved in the development of mRNA cell engineering technologies to repair cellular dysfunction and treat a range of therapeutic indications. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Ernexa Therapeutics, Inc. 從事提供細胞工程療法。它參與開發 mRNA 細胞工程技術來修復細胞功能障礙並治療一系列治療適應症。該公司成立於 1984 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. engages in the provision of software solutions and information technology professional services. It operates through the following segments: Matrix , Sapiens, Magic Software, Insync, Michpal, ZAP Group, and Other. The company was founded on April 2, 1985 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
info.description_zh: Formula Systems (1985) Ltd. 從事提供軟體解決方案和資訊科技專業服務。它透過以下部門運作：Matrix、Sapiens、Magic Software、Insync、Michpal、ZAP Group 和其他部門。該公司成立於1985年4月2日，總部位於以色列奧爾耶胡達。

info.description: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on May 14, 2018 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2018年5月14日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: BitFuFu Inc. engages in providing digital asset mining and cloud-mining services. The firm fosters a secure, compliant, and transparent blockchain infrastructure, providing a variety of stable and intelligent digital asset mining solutions to a global customer base. It leverages a global mining facility network and strategic partnership with Bitmain, which enables institutional customers and digital asset enthusiasts to mine digital assets. The company was founded by Leo Lu in December 2020 and is headquartered in Singapore.

info.description: Scharf Global Opportunity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund primarily invests in U.S. and non-U.S. equity securities that the Adviser believes have significantly more appreciation potential than downside risk over the long term. Equity securities in which the fund may invest include, but are not limited to, common and preferred stock of companies of all size market capitalizations, rights and warrants. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 40% of its total assets in non-U.S. securities. During unusual market conditions, the fund will invest at least 30% of its total assets in non-U.S. securities.
info.description_zh: Scharf Global Opportunity ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於顧問認為長期來看升值潛力明顯大於下行風險的美國和非美國股票證券。本基金可投資的股本證券包括但不限於各種市值公司的普通股和優先股、權利和認股權證。一般情況下，該基金將至少40%的總資產投資於非美國證券。在異常市場條件下，該基金將至少將其總資產的 30% 投資於非美國證券。
