Its properties include Flowerfield, Port Jefferson Professional Park, Courtland Medical Center, and Grove. The company was founded by Peter James Papadakos in 1946 and is headquartered in St. James, NY.

info.description: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of HOOD. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of HOOD and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF 寻求每日投资结果（未计费用和开支）为 HOOD 每日业绩的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 HOOD 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些組合起來為 HOOD 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: MicroCloud Hologram, Inc. engages in research, development, and application of holographic technology. It operates through the Holographic Solutions and Holographic Technology Service segments. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MicroCloud Hologram, Inc.從事全像技術的研究、開發與應用。它透過全息解決方案和全息技術服務部門運作。該公司成立於2020年，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long HOOD Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of HOOD. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 HOOD 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 HOOD 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 HOOD 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Robinhood Markets, Inc. (Nasdaq: HOOD). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Robinhood Markets, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：HOOD）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Werewolf Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of therapeutics engineered to stimulate the body's immune system for the treatment of cancer. The firm offers Predator Technology which focuses on immune targeting and activation. The company was founded by Daniel J. Hicklin, Patrick A. Baeuerle, and Luke B. Evnin on October 19, 2017 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Werewolf Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發旨在刺激人體免疫系統以治療癌症的療法。該公司提供專注於免疫靶向和活化的 Predator 技術。該公司由 Daniel J. Hicklin、Patrick A. Baeuerle 和 Luke B. Evnin 於 2017 年 10 月 19 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: HeartSciences, Inc. is a medical technology company, which focuses on applying innovative AI-based technology to an electrocardiogram (ECG) to expand and improve an ECG's clinical usefulness. Its objective is to make an ECG a far more valuable cardiac screening tool, particularly in frontline or point-of-care clinical settings. The firm offers MyoVista, a resting 12-lead ECG that is also designed to provide diagnostic information related to cardiac dysfunction. The company was founded on August 16, 2007 and is headquartered in Southlake, TX.
info.description_zh: HeartSciences, Inc. 是一家醫療技術公司，專注於將基於人工智慧的創新技術應用於心電圖 (ECG)，以擴展和提高心電圖的臨床實用性。其目標是使心電圖成為更有價值的心臟篩檢工具，特別是在前線或護理點臨床環境中。該公司提供 MyoVista，一種靜息 12 導程心電圖，也旨在提供與心臟功能障礙相關的診斷資訊。該公司成立於2007年8月16日，總部位於德克薩斯州南湖。

info.description: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc. engages in the research and development of oncology-focused precision medicine. The firm focuses on the targeted therapeutics for patients selected using molecular diagnostics. Its product candidate, IDE196, is a protein kinase C inhibitor for genetically defined cancers having GNAQ and GNA11 gene mutations. The company was founded by Yujiro S. Hata and Jeffrey Hager in June 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: IDEAYA Biosciences, Inc.從事以腫瘤學為重點的精準醫療的研發。該公司專注於為使用分子診斷選擇的患者提供標靶治療。其候選產品 IDE196 是一種蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑，用於治療具有 GNAQ 和 GNA11 基因突變的基因癌症。該公司由 Yujiro S. Hata 和 Jeffrey Hager 於 2015 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: JX Luxventure Group, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, distribution, and sale of casual menswear. The The company was founded by Anna Polemis on January 26, 2012, and is headquartered in Haikou, China.

info.description: Lotus Technology, Inc. engages in the design, development, and sale of battery for electronic vehicles through its subsidiaries. It also sells luxury sports cars under the Lotus brand. The company was founded on August 9, 2021 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. info.description: SPDR SSGA My2027 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2027, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2027 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2027 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Nicholas Bitcoin and Treasuries AfterDark ETF is an actively managed investment strategy designed to capture bitcoin's return profile specifically during U.S. overnight hours, from market close to the following market open. The fund maintains a dual-exposure structure, holding bitcoin-related instruments during the overnight session while rotating into short-term U.S. Treasuries and cash equivalents during U.S. daytime trading hours to potentially mitigate the volatility often associated with standard market sessions.
info.description_zh: Nicholas 比特幣與國債 AfterDark ETF 是一種主動管理的投資策略，旨在捕捉比特幣的回報情況，特別是在美國隔夜時段（從市場收盤到隨後的市場開盤）。該基金維持雙重曝險結構，在隔夜交易時段持有比特幣相關工具，同時在美國日間交易時段轉向短期美國國債和現金等價物，以潛在地減輕通常與標準市場交易時段相關的波動性。

info.description: NIP Group, Inc. is a digital entertainment company, which engages in the growing global audience of gaming and esports fans. It operates through the PRC and Other Subsidiaries and Ninjas in Pyjamas segments. It includes talent management, event production, hospitality, and game publishing businesses. It has operations in Sweden, China, Abu Dhabi, and Brazil, and its esports rosters participate across multiple game titles. The company was founded by Yau Kwan Ho and Hicham Chahine on February 5, 2021 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
info.description_zh: NIP Group, Inc. 是一家數位娛樂公司，面向全球不斷成長的遊戲和電競粉絲群。它透過中國及其他子公司和Ninjas in Pyjamas 部門運作。它包括人才管理、活動製作、酒店和遊戲發行業務。該公司在瑞典、中國、阿布達比和巴西都有業務，其電子競技陣容參與了多種遊戲。該公司由 Yau Kwan Ho 和 Hicham Chahine 於 2021 年 2 月 5 日創立，總部位於瑞典斯德哥爾摩。

info.description: OTG Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on June 12, 2025 and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: OTG Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 6 月 12 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF is an actively managed strategy designed to generate real returns and provide a direct hedge against rising inflation while minimizing the interest rate volatility typically associated with long-duration inflation-protected securities. The fund invests primarily in a diversified portfolio of short-term U.S. Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) and inflation-linked derivatives, utilizing PIMCO's macroeconomic research to tactically manage inflation breakeven positioning and duration.
info.description_zh: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF 是一種主動管理策略，旨在產生實際回報並提供對通膨上升的直接對沖，同時最大限度地減少通常與長期通膨保值證券相關的利率波動。該基金主要投資於短期美國國債通膨保值證券（TIPS）和通膨掛鉤衍生性商品的多元化投資組合，利用太平洋投資管理公司的宏觀經濟研究來戰術性地管理通膨盈虧平衡頭寸和久期。

info.description: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of specialty piping and leak detection systems. Its products include industrial and secondary containment piping systems for transporting chemicals, hazardous fluids and petroleum products, insulated and jacketed district heating and cooling piping systems for efficient energy distribution to multiple locations from central energy plants, and the coating and/or insulation of oil and gas gathering flow and long lines for oil or mineral transportation. The company was founded on October 12, 1993 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. 從事特種管道和洩漏檢測系統的設計、製造和銷售。其產品包括用於運輸化學品、危險流體和石油產品的工業和二次安全殼管道系統、用於從中央能源工廠向多個地點高效分配能源的隔熱和夾套區域供熱和冷卻管道系統，以及用於石油或礦物運輸的油氣集流和長管線的塗層和/或隔熱。該公司成立於1993年10月12日，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a biopharmaceutical company in Israel and internationally. It engages in the research and development of IL-17 NanoAb, a VHH-based antibody platform for the treatment of immune-mediated and inflammatory diseases, including psoriasis; and PC111, a human monoclonal antibody for the treatment of pemphigus, Steven Johnson's syndrome, and toxic epidermal necrolysis. The company also offers contract development and manufacturing organization services, such as analytical method development, process development, and cGMP manufacturing of clinical-stage materials to early-stage biotechnology companies. It has collaboration partnerships with Max Planck Society and University Medical Center Gottingen for the development of NanoAb candidates; and Recipharm Israel Ltd for the development of biologics and small-molecule programs. The company was formerly known as BiondVax Pharmaceuticals Ltd. and changed its name to Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. in September 2023. Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Jerusalem, Israel.

info.description: Sol Strategies, Inc. is an investment company. The firm is focused on the Solana ecosystem, which provides strategic investments and infrastructure solutions to enable decentralized finance. Its portfolio includes NGRAVE, Chia Network Inc., and zkSNACKS Limited. The company was founded on October 1, 2002 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Sol Strategies, Inc. 是一家投資公司。該公司專注於 Solana 生態系統，該生態系統提供策略性投資和基礎設施解決方案以實現去中心化金融。其投資組合包括 NGRAVE、Chia Network Inc. 和 zkSNACKS Limited。該公司成立於2002年10月1日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: SUI Group Holdings Ltd. engages in the business of providing short-term specialty finance solutions. The company was founded by Douglas Michael Polinsky and Joseph Anthony Geraci II on January 10, 2006 and is headquartered in Wayzata, MN.
info.description_zh: SUI Group Holdings Ltd.從事提供短期專業金融解決方案的業務。該公司由 Douglas Michael Polinsky 和 ​​Joseph Anthony Geraci II 於 2006 年 1 月 10 日創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州韋扎塔。

info.description: ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sale of precision fasteners, structural parts and other precision metal parts products. Its products include standard screws, nuts, bolts, turning parts, stamping parts and computer numerical control machining parts. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 中金康實業股份有限公司從事精密緊固件、結構件及其他精密金屬零件產品的製造及銷售。其產品包括標準螺絲、螺帽、螺栓、車削件、沖壓件和電腦數控加工件。公司成立於2011年，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Fulgent Genetics, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the provision of gene testing and sequencing solutions. It offers genes and panels, known mutation, hereditary cancer, carrier screening, and tumor profiling solutions. The company was founded by Ming Hsieh on May 13, 2016 and is headquartered in El Monte, CA.
info.description_zh: Fulgent Genetics, Inc.是一家提供基因測試和定序解決方案的科技公司。它提供基因和麵板、已知突變、遺傳性癌症、攜帶者篩檢和腫瘤分析解決方案。該公司由Ming Hsieh於2016年5月13日創立，總部位於加州埃爾蒙特。

info.description: EpicQuest Education Group International Ltd. engages in the provision of education solutions for domestic and international university students. It operates through the Foreign Language Education and Professional Training Programs. The company was founded by Jian Bo Zhang on December 13, 2017 and is headquartered in Toledo, OH.
info.description_zh: EpicQuest Education Group International Ltd.致力於為國內外大學生提供教育解決方案。它透過外語教育和專業培訓計畫運作。該公司由張建波於2017年12月13日創立，總部位於俄亥俄州托萊多。

info.description: SEI Select Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of emerging market issuers. The fund normally maintains investments in at least six emerging market countries, however, it may invest a substantial amount of its assets in issuers located in a single country or a limited number of countries.
info.description_zh: SEI Select 新興市場股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於新興市場發行人的股本證券。該基金通常在至少六個新興市場國家進行投資，但也可能將大量資產投資於位於單一國家或有限數量國家的發行人。

info.description: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities economically tied to emerging markets countries. The fund principally invests in equity securities, including common stock and preferred stock, of emerging markets companies, and in depositary receipts representing shares in such companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將其淨資產價值的至少80%加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與新興市場國家經濟相關的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場公司的股本證券，包括普通股和優先股，以及代表此類公司股份的存託憑證。

info.description: Perimeter Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase or similar business combination. The company was founded on March 6, 2025 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: Perimeter Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年3月6日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: First Trust High Income Strategic Focus ETF seeks risk-adjusted income; capital appreciation is the secondary objective. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by investing in a portfolio of U.S.-listed ETFs that is designed to follow the High Income Model developed by the advisor. The fund, through its investments in the underlying ETFs comprising the High Income Model, seeks to provide investors with a diversified income stream by holding a blend of fixed income assets that are actively managed to seek levels of high income and total return. It invests significantly in shares of the First Trust TCW Opportunistic Fixed Income ETF.
info.description_zh: First Trust High Income Strategy Focus ETF尋求風險調整後收益；資本增值是次要目標。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過投資於美國上市的 ETF 投資組合來實現其投資目標，該投資組合旨在遵循顧問開發的高收入模型。該基金透過對構成高收入模型的基礎 ETF 的投資，尋求透過持有積極管理的固定收益資產組合來為投資者提供多元化的收入來源，以尋求高收入和總回報水平。它大量投資於 First Trust TCW 機會性固定收益 ETF 的股票。

info.description: JPMorgan ActiveBuilders Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and equity-related instruments that are tied economically to emerging markets. The equity securities and equity-related instruments in which it may invest include, but are not limited to, common stock, participation notes or other structured notes, and other instruments that provide economic exposure to one or more equity securities. The fund may also use exchanged-traded futures for the efficient management of cash flows.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通 ActiveBuilders 新興市場股票 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於與新興市場經濟相關的股本證券和股票相關工具。其可能投資的股本證券及股本相關工具包括但不限於普通股、參與票據或其他結構性票據，以及提供一種或多種股本證券經濟風險的其他工具。該基金還可以使用交易所交易的期貨來有效管理現金流。

info.description: Nuveen Core Plus Bond ETF seeks total return, primarily through current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to pursue its investment objective by investing under normal market conditions, at least 80% of the sum of its net assets and the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in income producing fixed income securities.
info.description_zh: Nuveen Core Plus Bond ETF 主要透過當前收入尋求總回報。該基金是一種主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常市場條件下將其淨資產總和以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額的至少 80% 投資於產生收入的固定收益證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: CRISPR Therapeutics AG is a gene editing company, which engages in the development of transformative gene-based medicines for serious diseases using its proprietary CRISPR/Cas9 platform. Its CRISPR/Cas9 platform is a gene editing technology that allows for precise, directed changes to genomic DNA. The firm offers a portfolio of therapeutic programs across a broad range of disease areas including hemoglobinopathies, oncology, regenerative medicine, and rare diseases. The company was founded by Rodger Novak, Emmanuelle Charpentier, Shaun Patrick Foy, Matthew Porteus, Daniel Anderson, Chad Cowan, and Craig Mellow on October 31, 2013 and is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: CRISPR Therapeutics AG 是一家基因編輯公司，利用其專有的 CRISPR/Cas9 平台開發針對嚴重疾病的轉化基因藥物。其 CRISPR/Cas9 平台是一種基因編輯技術，可對基因組 DNA 進行精確、定向的改變。該公司提供涵蓋廣泛疾病領域的治療項目組合，包括血紅蛋白病、腫瘤學、再生醫學和罕見疾病。該公司由 Rodger Novak、Emmanuelle Charpentier、Shaun Patrick Foy、Matthew Porteus、Daniel Anderson、Chad Cowan 和 Craig Mellow 於 2013 年 10 月 31 日創立，總部位於瑞士楚格。

info.description: Xtrackers S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight Index. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of the constituent securities of the S&P 500 Index reweighted to mitigate concentration risk and address sector imbalances. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight ETF 尋求整體上與 S&P 500 Diversified Sector Weight Index 的表現（未計費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。基礎指數旨在追蹤重新加權的標準普爾 500 指數成分證券的表現，以減輕集中風險並解決產業失衡問題。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於基礎指數的組成證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: RF Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: RF Acquisition Corp. III 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月15日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2045 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2045 Maturity US Treasury Index. The index to track the investment results of an index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2045. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2045 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2045 年到期美國公債指數的投資結果。該指數追蹤由2045年到期的美國國債組成的指數的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的美國國債。該基金是非多元化的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2046 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2046 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2046. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2046 and December 15, 2046, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2046 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2046 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2046 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2046 年 1 月 1 日至 2046 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: Vaxcyte, Inc. engages in the development of vaccines for infectious diseases. It focuses on conjugate vaccines and protein-based vaccines developed through the Sutro Biopharma's Xpress CF Platform, a cell-free protein synthesis technology. The company was founded by Grant E. Pickering and Jeff Fairman on November 27, 2013, and is headquartered in San Carlos, CA.
info.description_zh: Vaxcyte, Inc. 從事傳染病疫苗的開發。它專注於透過 Sutro Biopharma 的 Xpress CF 平台（一種無細胞蛋白質合成技術）開發的結合疫苗和蛋白質疫苗。該公司由 Grant E. Pickering 和 Jeff Fairman 於 2013 年 11 月 27 日創立，總部位於加州聖卡洛斯。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2056 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2056 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2056. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2056 and December 15, 2056, inclusive. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2056 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤由 2056 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2056 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index 的投資結果。該基金通常尋求透過投資滿足基礎指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2056 年 1 月 1 日至 2056 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2055 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg December 2055 Maturity Corporate Index. The index seeks to track the investment results of an index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds maturing in 2055. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component instruments of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2055 定期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 2055 年 12 月到期企業指數的投資結果。該指數旨在追蹤由將於 2055 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債組成的指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成工具，而該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數中包含的固定收益證券類型，BFA 認為這些證券將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數。該基金是非多元化的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pliant Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the discovery, development and commercialization of therapies for fibrotic diseases. It offers a product discovery engine. The company is pursuing drug development programs for a range of fibrotic diseases, focusing on tissue-specific integrin modulation and TGF-ß1 signaling inhibition. The company was founded by Bradley Backes, Bill De Grado, Hal Chapman, and Dean Sheppard in June 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Pliant Therapeutics, Inc. 致力於纖維化疾病療法的發現、開發和商業化。它提供了一個產品發現引擎。該公司正在針對一系列纖維化疾病開展藥物開發計劃，重點關注組織特異性整合素調節和 TGF-ß1 訊號傳導抑制。該公司由 Bradley Backes、Bill De Grado、Hal Chapman 和 Dean Sheppard 於 2015 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 18, 2024 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年6月18日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq BuyWrite Income ETF seeks to provide current income. The fund will pursue its investment objective by investing primarily in equity securities listed on U.S. exchanges and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the Nasdaq-100 Index. The call options written by the fund will have expirations of less than one year, and will be typically written at-the-money to out-of-the-money.
info.description_zh: First Trust Nasdaq BuyWrite Income ETF 尋求提供當前收入。該基金將透過主要投資於美國交易所上市的股本證券以及利用「選擇權策略」來實現其投資目標，其中包括賣出（出售）納斯達克 100 指數的美國交易所交易看漲期權。該基金所簽發的買權的到期日將少於一年，並且通常會以平價或價外形式出售。

info.description: iShares Asia 50 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Asia 50TM composed of 50 of the largest Asian equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Asia 50 ETF 旨在追蹤由 50 隻最大的亞洲股票組成的 S&P Asia 50TM 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: 9F, Inc. is an Internet technology company, which operates as a digital financial account platform integrating and personalizing financial services. It provides financial products and services across loan products, online wealth management products, and payment facilitation, all integrated under a single digital financial account. The company was founded by Lei Liu and Li Xing Chen in August 2006 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 9F, Inc.是一家網路科技公司，致力於整合和個人化金融服務的數位金融帳戶平台。它提供涵蓋貸款產品、線上理財產品和支付便利的金融產品和服務，所有這些都整合在一個數位金融帳戶下。該公司由劉雷和陳李星於2006年8月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Incannex Healthcare, Inc. is a biotech company, which engages in developing cannabinoid and psychedelic compound medicines. It focuses on the research and development for medicinal cannabis pharmaceutical products and psychedelic medicine therapies for treatment of a range of indications. The company was founded on April 27, 2001 and is headquartered in Norwest, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Incannex Healthcare, Inc.是一家生技公司，致力於開發大麻素和迷幻化合物藥物。它專注於藥用大麻藥物和用於治療一系列適應症的迷幻藥物療法的研究和開發。該公司成立於2001年4月27日，總部位於澳洲諾韋斯特。

info.description: Greenpro Capital Corp. engages in the provision of business solution services to small and medium-size enterprises. It operates through the following business segments: Service Business, Digital Business, and Real Estate Business. The Service Business segment offers advisory and business solution services. The Digital Business segment focuses on the digital platform and trading of digital assets. The Real Estate Business segment trades or leases commercial real estate properties in Hong Kong and Malaysia. The company was founded by Lee Chong Kuang on July 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: 綠專資本致力於為中小企業提供商業解決方案服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務業務、數位業務和房地產業務。服務業務部門提供諮詢和業務解決方案服務。數位業務部門專注於數位平台和數位資產交易。房地產業務部門在香港和馬來西亞交易或租賃商業房地產。該公司由李宗光於2013年7月19日創立，總部位於馬來西亞吉隆坡。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST IONQ ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on IonQ, Inc. 's commons share (NYSE: IONQ) by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST IONQ ETF 尋求透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收益是透過出售 IonQ, Inc. 普通股（NYSE：IONQ）選擇權產生的，該基金旨在實現基礎股票上限 每日表現的 2 倍（200%），並獲得基礎槓桿收益的投資上限。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於以標的槓桿ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of human therapeutic drugs using antisense technology. The company was founded by Stanley T. Crooke, David J. Ecker, Christopher K. Mirabelli, and Brett P. Monia on January 10, 1989 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 利用反義技術從事人類治療藥物的開發和商業化。該公司由 Stanley T. Crooke、David J. Ecker、Christopher K. Mirabelli 和 Brett P. Monia 於 1989 年 1 月 10 日創立，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Coya Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company which engages in developing proprietary medicinal products to modulate the function of regulatory T cells. The company was founded by Howard Berman in 2020 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Coya Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發調節調節性T細胞功能的專有醫藥產品。該公司由 Howard Berman 於 2020 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Aclarion, Inc. is a healthcare technology company, which engages in the provision of Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy (MRS), and a proprietary biomarker to optimize clinical treatments. It utilizes Artificial Intelligence to assist in quality control processes that flag spectroscopy data indicative of a poor MRS study. It offers NOCISCAN Suite, a revolutionary software suite that works with existing high field Magnetic Resonance systems and Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy pulse sequence packages using an optimized protocol to conduct MRS exams of lumbar discs. The company was founded by James C. Peacock, David S. Bradford, and Jeffrey Lotz in 2008 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Aclarion, Inc. 是一家醫療保健技術公司，致力於提供磁振造影波譜 (MRS) 和用於優化臨床治療的專有生物標記。它利用人工智慧來協助品質控制過程，標記表明 MRS 研究不佳的光譜數據。它提供 NOCISCAN Suite，這是一款革命性的軟體套件，可與現有的高場磁共振系統和磁共振波譜脈衝序列包配合使用，使用優化的協議對腰椎間盤進行 MRS 檢查。該公司由 James C. Peacock、David S. Bradford 和 Jeffrey Lotz 於 2008 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company. It engages in the development of medicines for unmet medical needs. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Millbrae, CA.
info.description_zh: Eikon Therapeutics 是一家生物製藥公司。它致力於開發藥物以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。該公司成立於 2019 年，總部位於加州米爾布雷。

info.description: Matthews China Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews China Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過利用人工智慧增強的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市大型資本公司的證券。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Baba ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the ADR of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE: BABA) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying BABA ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Baba ETF 尋求當前收入；接觸一隻或多只交易所交易基金的業績，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為阿里巴巴集團控股有限公司（紐約證券交易所股票代碼：BABA）每日美國存託憑證百分比的兩倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於以基礎BABA ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Bunge Global SA engages in agribusiness including food and ingredients. It operates through the following segments: Agribusiness, Refined & Specialty Oils, Milling, Sugar & Bioenergy, and Corporate & Other. The Agribusiness segment is an integrated, global business principally involved in the purchase, storage, transportation, processing and sale of agricultural commodities and commodity products. The Refined & Specialty Oils segment includes businesses that sell vegetable oils and fats, including cooking oils, shortenings, specialty ingredients, and renewable diesel feedstocks. The Milling segment refers to the businesses that sell wheat flours, bakery mixes, and corn-based products. The Sugar & Bioenergy segment consists of results from the company's previously owned 50% ownership interest in BP Bunge Bioenergia. The Corporate & Other segment focuses on the salaries and overhead for corporate functions that are not allocated to individual reporting segments because the operating performance of such reporting segments is evaluated. It connects farmers to consumers to deliver essential and sustainable food, feed and fuel. The company was founded on February 14, 2023 and is headquartered in Chesterfield, MO.
info.description_zh: Bunge Global SA 從事農業綜合業務，包括食品和配料。它透過以下部門運作：農業綜合企業、精煉和特種油、製粉、糖和生物能源以及企業和其他部門。農業綜合企業部門是一家綜合性、全球性企業，主要涉及農產品和大宗商品的採購、儲存、運輸、加工和銷售。精煉和特種油部門包括銷售植物油和脂肪的業務，包括食用油、起酥油、特殊成分和再生柴油原料。製粉部門是指銷售小麥麵粉、烘焙混合物和玉米產品的業務。糖業和生質能源部門包括該公司先前擁有 BP Bunge Bioenergia 50% 股權的表現。公司及其他分部重點關注公司職能的薪資和間接費用，這些職能未分配給各個報告分部，因為要評估此類報告分部的經營業績。它將農民與消費者聯繫起來，提供基本且永續的食品、飼料和燃料。該公司成立於 2023 年 2 月 14 日，總部位於密蘇裡州切斯特菲爾德。

info.description: Skillful Craftsman Education Technology Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of online education and technology services. Its online education services are comprised of online vocational training and virtual simulation experimental training. It also operates the following education platforms: lifelong education public service platform, online vocational training platform, and virtual simulation experimental training platform. The company was founded by Xiao Feng Gao and Lu Gang Hua in 2013 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 巧匠教育科技有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供線上教育和技術服務。其線上教育服務包括線上職業培訓和虛擬模擬實驗培訓。也經營終身教育公共服務平台、線上職業培訓平台、虛擬模擬實驗實務平台等教育平台。該公司由高曉峰和盧剛華於2013年創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Bridgewater Bancshares, Inc. is a holding company, which provides retail and commercial loan and deposit services. It offers deposits, lending, professional services, and business services. The company was founded by Jerry J. Baack and Jeffrey D. Shellberg in 2005 and is headquartered in St. Louis Park, MN.
info.description_zh: Bridgewater Bancshares, Inc. 是一家控股公司，提供零售和商業貸款和存款服務。它提供存款、貸款、專業服務和商業服務。該公司由 Jerry J. Baack 和 Jeffrey D. Shellberg 於 2005 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州聖路易斯帕克。

info.description: Greenlane Holdings, Inc. engages in acquisition, staking, validator participation, and strategic deployment of digital assets. It operates through the following segments: Wholesale and Distribution and Digital Assets. The Wholesale and Distribution segment includes legacy e-commerce and drop-ship operations. The Digital Assets segment focuses on activities including acquisition, staking and validator participation. The company was founded by Aaron LoCascio in 2005 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Greenlane Holdings, Inc. 從事數位資產的收購、質押、驗證者參與和策略部署。它透過以下部門運作：批發和分銷部門以及數位資產部門。批發和分銷部門包括傳統的電子商務和代發貨業務。數位資產部門專注於收購、質押和驗證者參與等活動。該公司由 Aaron LoCascio 於 2005 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Oculis Holding AG is a global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in sight and improving eye care. The firm's pipeline includes multiple product candidates in development such as, OCS-01, a topical retinal candidate for diabetic macular edema, OCS-02, a topical biologic candidate for dry eye disease, and OCS-05, a disease modifying candidate for acute optic neuritis and other neuro-ophtha disorders such as glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, geographic atrophy, and neurotrophic keratitis. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Zug, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Oculis Holding AG 是一家全球生物製藥公司，致力於視力和改善眼部護理。該公司的產品線包括多種正在開發的候選產品，例如 OCS-01（一種治療糖尿病黃斑水腫的局部視網膜候選藥物）、OCS-02（一種治療乾眼症的局部生物候選藥物）和 OCS-05（一種治療急性視神經炎和其他神經眼病（如青光眼、糖尿病視網膜病變、地圖樣萎縮和神經營養性角膜炎）。該公司成立於2016年，總部位於瑞士楚格。

info.description: InflaRx NV is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of inhibitors of the complement activation factor known as C5a and its receptor C5aR. Its primary product candidate is Vilobelimab. The company was founded by Niels Christoph Riedemann, Renfeng Guo, and Nicolas Fulpius in December 2007 and is headquartered in Jena, Germany.
info.description_zh: InflaRx NV 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於補體活化因子 C5a 及其受體 C5aR 抑制劑的發現和開發。其主要候選產品為 Vilobelimab。該公司由 Niels Christoph Riedemann、RenfengGuo 和 Nicolas Fulpius 於 2007 年 12 月創立，總部位於德國耶拿。

info.description: Direxion Daily LLY Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of LLY. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of LLY and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to LLY, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily LLY Bull 2X Shares 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 LLY 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 LLY 證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 LLY 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in mRNA cell therapies for the treatment of autoimmune diseases. It operates in research and development of cell therapy product candidates. The company was founded on December 10, 2007 is headquartered in Frederick, MD.
info.description_zh: Cartesian Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，從事治療自體免疫疾病的 mRNA 細胞療法。它從事細胞治療產品候選產品的研究和開發。該公司成立於2007年12月10日，總部位於馬裡蘭州弗雷德里克。

info.description: Editas Medicine, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of genome editing technology. Its technology includes clustered, regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR), and CRISPR associated protein 9 (Cas9). The company was founded by Feng Zhang, Jennifer A. Doudna, George McDonald Church, J. Keith Joung and David R. Liu on September 3, 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Editas Medicine, Inc. 從事基因組編輯技術的開發和商業化。其技術包括成簇、規則間隔的短回文重複序列 (CRISPR) 和 CRISPR 相關蛋白 9 (Cas9)。該公司由 Feng Zhang、Jennifer A. Doudna、George McDonald Church、J. Keith Joung 和 David R. Liu 於 2013 年 9 月 3 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Intelligent Protection Management Corp. engages in the development of communications software to enhance security and privacy solutions for multimedia communication and data transmission. Its solutions include blockchain strategy consulting, blockchain implementation, white label video solutions, and technology licensing. The firm's product portfolio includes Paltalk and Camfrog. The company was founded by Clifford Lerner and Darrell Lerner on July 19, 2005 and is headquartered in Jericho, NY.
info.description_zh: Intelligence Protection Management Corp. 從事通訊軟體開發，以增強多媒體通訊和資料傳輸的安全和隱私解決方案。其解決方案包括區塊鏈戰略諮詢、區塊鏈實施、白標視訊解決方案和技術許可。該公司的產品組合包括 Paltalk 和 Camfrog。該公司由 Clifford Lerner 和 Darrell Lerner 於 2005 年 7 月 19 日創立，總部位於紐約州傑里科。

info.description: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. engages in the research and development of engineered cells as medicine. It focuses on identifying and developing potential product candidates, executing preclinical studies, and acquiring technology. The company was founded by Steven D. Harr, Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert Taylor Nelsen, and Hans Edgar Bishop on July 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. 從事工程細胞藥物的研究和開發。它專注於識別和開發潛在的候選產品、執行臨床前研究以及獲取技術。該公司由 Steven D. Harr、Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert Taylor Nelsen 和 Hans Edgar Bishop 於 2018 年 7 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: CLPS, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of information technology, consulting, and solution services to banking, insurance, and financial sectors. It operates through the IT Services and Academic Education Services segments. The company was founded by Ming Hui Ling on August 30, 2005 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: CLPS, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於為銀行、保險和金融業提供資訊科技、諮詢和解決方案服務。它透過 IT 服務和學術教育服務部門運作。該公司由明慧玲於2005年8月30日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 200 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 2,000 securities ranked 1,001 to 3,000 by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA SmallCap Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright SmallCap Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由約 200 種證券組成，這些證券來自納斯達克美國基準指數市值排名 1,001 至 3,000 的約 2,000 種合格證券。

info.description: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. is a clinical-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in biotechnology and drug design and development. The company was founded in 2018, and is headquartered in Somerville, MA.
info.description_zh: Generate Biomedicines, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生成生物學公司，引領生物技術和藥物設計與開發領域的人工智慧革命。該公司成立於 2018 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州薩默維爾。

info.description: ZeroStack Corp. engages in the production of organic cannabis and pharmaceutical-grade medical products. It operates through the House of Brands and Commercial and Wholesale segments. The House of Brands segment includes multiple categories including food and beverage, nutraceuticals, cannabis accessories and technology, personal care and wellness. The Commercial and Wholesale segment includes distribution of pharmaceutical products to international markets. The company was founded on March 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: ZeroStack Corp. 從事有機大麻和醫藥級醫療產品的生產。它透過品牌之家以及商業和批發部門運作。 House of Brands 部門包括多個類別，包括食品和飲料、營養保健品、大麻配件和技術、個人護理和健康。商業和批發部門包括向國際市場分銷藥品。該公司成立於2019年3月13日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Alpha Architect U.S. Quantitative Momentum ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Adviser employs a multi-step, quantitative, rules-based methodology to identify a portfolio of approximately 50 to 100 equity securities with the highest relative momentum. A "momentum" style of investing emphasizes investing in securities that have had higher recent total return performance compared to other securities. The Adviser then employs proprietary screens to eliminate companies with issues that may negatively impact their momentum. The fund may also invest up to 20% of its assets in cash and cash equivalents, other investment companies, as well as securities and other instruments.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect美國量化動量ETF尋求長期資本增值。該顧問採用多步驟、定量、基於規則的方法來確定由大約 50 至 100 種相對動量最高的股票證券組成的投資組合。 「動量」投資風格強調投資於近期總回報表現高於其他證券的證券。然後，顧問採用專有篩選來消除存在可能對其發展勢頭產生負面影響的問題的公司。該基金還可以將最多 20% 的資產投資於現金和現金等價物、其他投資公司以及證券和其他工具。

info.description: Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc. is a cell therapy clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the provision of treatments and potential cures for serious autoimmune diseases. The company was founded in June 2018 and is headquartered in Emeryville, CA.
info.description_zh: Kyverna Therapeutics, Inc.是一家細胞治療臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於為嚴重的自體免疫疾病提供治療和潛在治癒方法。該公司成立於 2018 年 6 月，總部位於加州埃默里維爾。

info.description: Ocugen, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapies to cure eye diseases. Its product pipeline candidates include OCU400, OCU410, OCU200, and COVAXIN. The firm's modifier gene therapy platform is engaged in addressing retinal diseases, including retinitis pigmentosa, leber congenital amaurosis, and dry age-related macular degeneration. The company was founded by Shankar Musunuri and Uday B. Kompella in 2013 and is headquartered in Malvern, PA.
info.description_zh: Ocugen, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於眼部疾病療法的開發和商業化。其候選產品包括OCU400、OCU410、OCU200和COVAXIN。該公司的修飾基因治療平台致力於解決視網膜疾病，包括色素性視網膜炎、萊伯先天性黑蒙和乾性老年黃斑部病變。該公司由 Shankar Musunuri 和 Uday B. Kompella 於 2013 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州馬爾文。

info.description: SKK Holdings Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in the provision of civil engineering services in subsurface utility works, including power and telecommunication cable laying, water pipeline and sewer rehabilitation works. The company was founded by Chun Seong Ng and Koon Kiat Sze on October 16, 2013 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: SKK Holdings Ltd.作為一家控股公司運營，從事提供地下公用事業工程的土木工程服務，包括電力和電信電纜鋪設、供水管道和下水道修復工程。該公司由Chun Seong Ng和Koon Kiat Sze於2013年10月16日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Republic Power Group Ltd. operates as a provider of ERP software solutions, consulting and technical support services, and peripheral hardware to large and SME clients and government agencies based in Singapore and Malaysia. It is focused on delivering customized ERP systems for airports, cruise terminals, technology companies. The company was founded on November 17, 2021 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Republic Power Group Ltd. 是一家為新加坡和馬來西亞的大型和中小企業客戶以及政府機構提供 ERP 軟體解決方案、諮詢和技術支援服務以及外圍硬體的供應商。它專注於為機場、郵輪碼頭、科技公司提供客製化的 ERP 系統。該公司成立於2021年11月17日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Top KingWin Ltd. is a holding company that engages in the provision of corporate business training, corporate consulting, and advisory and transaction services. It provides customized software development, technology solutions, and peripheral hardware to clients, and focusing on fields such as intelligent manufacturing, urban construction, and healthcare industry. The company was founded by Rui Lin Xu in 2020 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: Top KingWin Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供企業業務培訓、企業諮詢以及諮詢和交易服務。為客戶提供客製化軟體開發、技術解決方案及週邊硬件，重點在於智慧製造、城市建設、醫療健康等領域。該公司由徐瑞林於2020年創立，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: GDS Holdings Ltd. engages in developing and operating data centers in China. It builds, operates, and transfers data centers at other locations. Its data centers are carrier and cloud-neutral, which enable customers to connect to major telecommunications carriers, and to access a number of cloud service providers. The firm also offers colocation and managed services, which include direct private connection to major public cloud platforms. The company was founded by William Wei Huang in 2001 and is headquartered in Pudong, China.
info.description_zh: 萬國資料控股有限公司在中國從事資料中心的開發和營運。它在其他地點建立、運作和轉移資料中心。其資料中心與營運商和雲端無關，使客戶能夠連接到主要電信營運商，並存取許多雲端服務供應商。該公司還提供託管和託管服務，其中包括與主要公有雲平台的直接私人連接。該公司由William Wei Huang於2001年創立，總部位於中國浦東。

info.description: NN, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture high-precision components and assemblies primarily for the electrical, automotive, general industrial, aerospace and defense, and medical markets. It operates through the Mobile Solutions and Power Solutions segments. The Mobile Solutions segment manufactures system critical components for fuel systems, engines and transmissions, power steering systems, and electromechanical motors. The Power Solutions segment designs and produces a broad range of high-precision metal and plastic components, assemblies, and finished devices used in applications ranging from power control to flight control, and for military devices. The company was founded by Richard D. Ennen in October 1980 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: NN, Inc. 致力於設計和製造高精度零件和組件，主要面向電氣、汽車、一般工業、航空航太和國防以及醫療市場。它透過行動解決方案和電源解決方案部門運作。行動解決方案部門生產燃油系統、引擎和變速箱、動力轉向系統和機電馬達的系統關鍵部件。電源解決方案部門設計和生產各種高精度金屬和塑膠零件、組件和成品設備，用於從電源控製到飛行控制以及軍事設備等應用。該公司由 Richard D. Ennen 於 1980 年 10 月創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Anteris Technologies Global Corp. is a structural heart company, which engages in the development and commercialization of medical devices for heart diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, Australia, Switzerland, and Sweden. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Eagan, MN.
info.description_zh: Anteris Technologies Global Corp.是一家結構心臟公司，從事心臟病醫療設備的開發和商業化。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國、澳洲、瑞士和瑞典。該公司成立於 1999 年，總部位於明尼蘇達州伊根。

info.description: Atossa Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of novel therapeutics and delivery methods for the treatment of breast cancer and other breast conditions. The company was founded by Steven C. Quay and Shu Chih Chen in December 2008 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Atossa Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發治療乳癌和其他乳房疾病的新型療法和遞送方法。該公司由 Steven C. Quay 和 Shu Chih Chen 於 2008 年 12 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long IONQ ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of IonQ, Inc. (NYSE: IONQ). The fund is an actively managed ETF that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 IONQ ETF 尋求 IonQ, Inc.（NYSE：IONQ）每日股價變動百分比兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Himax Technologies, Inc. is a semiconductor solution provider dedicated to display imaging processing technologies. It operates through the Driver Integrated Circuit and Non-Driver Products segments. The company's products include display drivers, timing controllers, wafer level optics, video and display technology solutions, liquid crystal over silicon silicon, complementary metal-oxide semiconductor image sensor, and power integrated circuit. Its products used in TVs, laptops, monitors, mobile phones, tablets, digital cameras, car navigation, virtual reality (VR) devices and many other consumer electronics devices. Himax Technologies was founded by Biing Seng Wu and Jordan Wu on June 12, 2001 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: 奇景光電 (Himax Technologies, Inc.) 是一家致力於顯示影像處理技術的半導體解決方案供應商。它透過驅動器積體電路和非驅動器產品部門運作。該公司的產品包括顯示驅動器、時序控制器、晶圓級光學元件、視訊和顯示技術解決方案、矽基液晶、互補金屬氧化物半導體影像感測器和功率集成電路。其產品應用於電視、筆記型電腦、顯示器、手機、平板電腦、數位相機、汽車導航、虛擬實境（VR）設備和許多其他消費性電子設備。奇景科技由 Bing Seng Wu 和 Jordan Wu 於 2001 年 6 月 12 日創立，總部位於台灣台南。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MRVL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MRVL Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Marvell Technology, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MRVL）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入掉期和選擇權標的股票等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Arbe Robotics Ltd. develops radar and operating system for drones, automotive, and robots. It provides 4D imaging radar solution for autonomous vehicles. The company was founded by Kobi Marenko, Noam Arkind and Oz Fixman on 4th November, 2015 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.description_zh: Arbe Robotics Ltd. 為無人機、汽車和機器人開發雷達和作業系統。它為自動駕駛車輛提供4D成像雷達解決方案。該公司由 Kobi Marenko、Noam Arkind 和 Oz Fixman 於 2015 年 11 月 4 日創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of lifecycle automotive services. It operates through the following segments: New Car Sales, Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales, and Automotive Insurance Related Services. The New Car Sales segment offers parallel import car and new energy vehicle (NEV). The Auto Parts and Auto Accessories Sales segment conducts business primarily to auto part dealers and gradually upgrade to directly connect to local multiple-brand-service (MBS) stores. The Automotive Insurance Related Services segment refers to the value-added maintenance, claim and repair, and insurance intermediation services. The company was founded by Hou Qi Zhang in 2010 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Autozi互聯網科技（全球）有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供汽車全生命週期服務。它透過以下部門運作：新車銷售、汽車零件和汽車配件銷售以及汽車保險相關服務。新車銷售部門提供平行進口汽車和新能源汽車（NEV）。汽車零配件銷售板塊主要針對汽車零配件經銷商開展業務，並逐步升級為直連當地多品牌服務（MBS）店。汽車保險相關服務部門是指加值保養、索賠和維修以及保險中介服務。該公司由張侯奇於2010年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Corning, Inc. engages in the provision of glass for notebook computers, flat panel desktop monitors, display televisions, and other information display applications, carrier network and enterprise network products for the telecommunications industry, ceramic substrates for gasoline and diesel engines in automotive and heavy-duty vehicle markets, laboratory products for the scientific community and polymer products for biotechnology applications, optical materials for the semiconductor industry and the scientific community, and polycrystalline silicon products and other technologies. It operates through the following segments: Optical Communications, Display, Specialty Materials, Automotive, and Life Sciences. The Optical Communications segment is classified into two main product groupings: carrier and enterprise network. The carrier network group consists of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data, and voice communications. The enterprise network group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments, and individuals for their own use. The Display Technologies segment manufactures glass substrates for flat panel displays, including organic light-emitting diodes and liquid crystal displays that are used primarily in televisions, notebook computers, desktop monitors, tablets, and handheld devices. The Specialty Materials segment is involved in the manufacture of products that provide material formulations for glass, glass ceramics and crystals, and precision metrology instruments and software. The Automotive segment manufactures ceramic substrates and filter products for emissions control in mobile applications around the world as well as technical glass and optic products and solutions for the interior and exterior of vehicles. The Life Sciences segment develops, manufactures, and supplies laboratory products. The company was founded by Amory Houghton Sr. in 1851 and is headquartered in Corning, NY.
info.description_zh: 康寧公司致力於為筆記型電腦、平板桌上型顯示器、顯示器電視和其他資訊顯示應用提供玻璃，為電信業提供營運商網路和企業網路產品，為汽車和重型汽車市場的汽油和柴油引擎提供陶瓷基板，為科學界提供實驗室產品，為生物技術應用提供聚合物產品，為半導體產業和科學界提供光學材料，以及多晶矽產品和其他技術。它透過以下部門運作：光通訊、顯示器、特殊材料、汽車和生命科學。光通訊領域分為兩個主要產品組：營運商網路和企業網路。營運商網路集團包括用於視訊、數據和語音通訊等服務的光通訊基礎設施的產品和解決方案。企業網路組主要由出售給企業、政府和個人供其自用的基於光的通訊網路組成。顯示技術部門生產用於平面顯示器的玻璃基板，包括主要用於電視、筆記型電腦、桌上型顯示器、平板電腦和手持設備的有機發光二極管和液晶顯示器。特種材料部門從事為玻璃、玻璃陶瓷和晶體提供材料配方的產品的製造，以及精密計量儀器和軟體。汽車部門生產用於全球移動應用排放控制的陶瓷基板和過濾器產品，以及用於車輛內部和外部的技術玻璃和光學產品和解決方案。生命科學部門開發、製造和供應實驗室產品。該公司由 Amory Houghton Sr. 於 1851 年創立，總部位於紐約州康寧。

info.description: ARB IOT Group Ltd. is a holding company that engages in the provision of solutions for the integration of IoT systems and devices. It operates through the Internet of Things and Investment Holding and Others segments. The company was founded on March 1, 2022 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: ARB IOT Group Ltd.是一家控股公司，致力於提供物聯網系統和設備整合解決方案。它透過物聯網和投資控股及其他部門運作。該公司成立於2022年3月1日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: AIOS Tech, Inc. engages in the strategic transformation plan, is repositioning itself as a provider of artificial intelligence and technology-driven professional services. The firm delivering innovative information technology solutions, advanced data services, and AI-powered offerings to a diverse range of commercial client base. The core business encompasses digital transformation services, customized IT solutions for the financial sector, enterprise data solutions, and the development of artificial intelligence platforms and infrastructure, aiming to enhance operational efficiency and drive growth for clients across multiple industries. The company was founded on May 29, 2012 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: AIOS Tech, Inc.正在進行策略轉型計劃，將自身重新定位為人工智慧和技術驅動的專業服務提供者。該公司為各種商業客戶群提供創新的資訊技術解決方案、先進的數據服務和人工智慧驅動的產品。核心業務涵蓋數位轉型服務、金融業客製化IT解決方案、企業數據解決方案以及人工智慧平台和基礎設施開發，旨在提升各產業客戶的營運效率並推動成長。公司成立於2012年5月29日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. is dedicated to building an ecosystem that integrates AI and blockchain while bridging Web2 and Web3. Its core products include the BesTrade DeAI Agent and the AIxC ecosystem products. The company was founded on March 29, 2004 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc.致力於建立一個融合人工智慧和區塊鏈、連接Web2和Web3的生態系統。其核心產品包括BesTrade DeAI Agent和AIxC生態產品。該公司成立於2004年3月29日，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Moderna, Inc. engages in the development of transformative medicines based on messenger ribonucleic acid. The firm's product pipeline includes the following modalities: prophylactic vaccines, cancer vaccines, intratumoral immuno-oncology, localized regenerative therapeutics, systemic secreted therapeutics, inhaled pulmonary therapeutics and systemic intracellular therapeutics. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Europe, and Rest of World. The company was founded by Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert S. Langer, Jr., Derrick J. Rossi, and Kenneth R. Chien in 2010 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Moderna, Inc. 致力於開發基於信使核糖核酸的轉化藥物。該公司的產品線包括以下模式：預防性疫苗、癌症疫苗、腫瘤內免疫腫瘤學、局部再生療法、全身性分泌療法、吸入性肺部療法和全身性細胞內療法。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲和世界其他地區。該公司由 Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert S. Langer, Jr.、Derrick J. Rossi 和 Kenneth R. Chien 於 2010 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Flux Power Holdings, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and sale of rechargeable lithium-ion energy storage systems for industrial applications. It focuses on electric forklifts and airport ground support equipment. The company was founded by Christopher L. Anthony and Michael Johnson on September 21, 1998 and is headquartered in Vista, CA.
